За останні 3 роки та 8 місяців (44 місяці або 1350 днів) ворог захопив 23% Донецької області, а під контролем Сил Оборони України залишається 22.6% Хоч динаміка окупації Донеччини залишається у розрізі щоденних оновлень доволі жвавою, але в контексті контролю над усієї областю — дуже повільною. До повномасштабного вторгнення бойовики терористичних проросійських угруповань контролювали приблизно 32% області. За перші 40 днів вторгнення через провал оборони на півдні України та оточення Маріуполя, кацап зумів захопити ще 22.4% Донеччини. Після цього темпи просування спали, адже Сили Оборони стали від Великої Новосілки до Вугледару, а кацап стирався у штурмах ДонУРу (Донецького укріпленого району). Історичний факт, що німецький Вермахт за неповні 47 місяців умудрився від Західного Бугу дійти до Москви та Сталінграду, а також повернутися в Берлін. Натомість "друга армія світу" за майже аналогічний період дійшла від Донецька до Покровська. Яким чином американські партнери вважають такий "черепаховий наступ" козирем — зрозуміти складно. Хоча, звісно, і ми не в змозі за нинішньої конфігурації сил звільнити всі міжнародно визнані території. В цілому, якщо великих змін не буде, то для окупації всієї Донеччини кацапам треба буде не менше 3 років. І в чому тут козир — пишіть у коментарях до публікації. Video

Czemu więc, skoro ten ośrodek powstał, nie otworzyć go dla ludzi, dla młodzieży, dla intelektualistów? Ja nic więcej nie potrzebuję, a jest tu przestrzeń do tego, żeby zorganizować bardzo atrakcyjne spotkania. 💬 Złota klatka to model zaproponowany w polskim systemie politycznym dla Prezydenta, ale trudno mnie w niej zamknąć. Ani żyrandole nie robią na mnie wielkiego wrażenia, ani nawet najpiękniejsze ośrodki. To, czego potrzebuje każdy Prezydent Polski, to opinia różnych środowisk – niezależnie od wieku i reprezentowanej konwencji. 💬 (o nadchodzącym wydarzeniu z udziałem młodych) Zawsze byłem blisko, lubiłem się wsłuchiwać w głos młodzieży. Nie zmieni się to, gdy jestem Prezydentem Polski, więc z jednej strony to będą dyskusje i w tym sensie formacja czy dyskusja o przyszłości Polski, a z drugiej strony też dużo rozrywki, myślę, także takiej, która zaskoczy.

Madras High Court extends stay on 5 Tamil Nadu Bypolls The Election Commission of India informed the Madras High Court that it will not notify bypolls for five Assembly constituencies until pending election petitions are decided. The Madras High Court has extended the interim stay on notifying the bypolls till September 8. It rejected the TVK government's plea to vacate the stay. The five constituencies are Tiruchy East, Viralimalai, Perundurai, Ambasamudram and Karur. The ECI's submission that it has no plan to announce the bypolls till the election cases are over was opposed by Chief Minister Vijay's side. The state government has sought an early hearing of the case seeking a stay on the bypolls. The stay continues as election petitions challenging the victories in these five seats are still pending.

VIDEO | Delhi: On the surge in influenza A cases in the national capital, Dr Naresh Kumar, HOD, Department of Pulmonary Medicine, LNJP Hospital, says, “Influenza is basically the common flu, which comes and goes every year, such as influenza A and B. The H1N1 strain that is being discussed is also a subtype of influenza A, so the symptoms are similar. These include cold, cough, runny nose, fever, sore throat and body aches. Sometimes, in children, H1N1 can cause more pronounced gastrointestinal symptoms, such as diarrhoea and vomiting. Generally, people recover within three to four days. Only a very small percentage of cases require hospitalisation or a doctor's visit. It spreads through droplet transmission, so all necessary precautions should be taken to prevent the spread. Follow cough etiquette and avoid coughing directly towards another person's face. We have become much more alert about such infections after COVID. Just as we followed measures to protect ourselves from infection during COVID, we should continue following similar precautions routinely.” (Full video available on PTI Videos - ptivideos.com) Video

“QUÉ DICE EL REGISTRO ARGENTINO QUE ASOCIA LA MUERTE SÚBITA DEPORTIVA CON EL ESFUERZO FÍSICO” La muerte súbita asociada al deporte mostró en la Argentina un patrón concentrado durante el esfuerzo y en personas con posible patología subyacente, ya sea previa o congénita, según el primer análisis preliminar del Registro Argentino de Muerte Súbita Asociada al Deporte (RAMSAD). El relevamiento reunió 27 episodios ocurridos entre el 5 de noviembre de 2025 y el 21 de junio de 2026, y señaló que casi nueve de cada diez se produjeron mientras se realizaba actividad física. El informe indicó que 24 de los 27 casos sucedieron durante la práctica deportiva, y que los tres restantes aparecieron dentro de la primera hora posterior al ejercicio. Los responsables del registro advirtieron que se trata de una descripción inicial de notificaciones voluntarias, con información faltante en varias variables, por lo que no representa necesariamente la totalidad de los eventos ocurridos en el país. Situation on the Orikhiv & Omelnyk directions, Zaporizhzhia Oblast: Over the last week, Russian forces have continued their storming operations on Orikhiv, while making additional advances from the east. In the southwest, Russian forces continued infiltrating through Novodanylivka to the southeastern part of Orikhiv, where fighting is slowly shifting towards the city centre. Russia is unable to gain a foothold here, however, due to the continued presence of Ukrainian formations in Novodanylivka, where fighting is ongoing. Russian forces are also attempting to infiltrate the forests west of Mala Tokmachka, which, if captured, they could use to accumulate and enter Orikhiv in much larger numbers. To the east, the Russians continued advancing northeast of Mala Tokmachka, capturing new positions along the tactical heights, and further threatening Ukrainian formations in Bilohirya with encirclement. They are now actively trying to capture positions in and around the forests further west, in coordination with infiltrations north from Mala Tokmachka towards the nearby trench fortification network. Heavy fighting continues for Mala Tokmachka itself. To the northeast, Russian forces improved their positions west and southwest of Charivne, and are continuing attempts at infiltrating up to the eastern and western parts of Novoselivka. Meanwhile, heavy fighting continues for fields west of Hirke and Verkhnya Tersa, as Russian assault groups continue attempts at advancing towards Kopani, Babashi, Rivne, and Dolynka. + ~6.08 km² in favour of Russia.

Weekend Ukraine map summary thread 🧵 for Sunday 23rd August 2026 Ukrainian midrange strikes hit Anapa airport, striking an Su-30SM or Su-33 and MiG-29 (h/t @MarcinRogowsk14 for keeping the aviation side honest) amongst other targets. An Su-24 was claimed hit at Saki air base too on the 20th August, but no imagery seen. Primorsk-Akhtarsk air base was also hit, destroying numerous drone hangars and radars - the only imagery we have is Sentinel thus far. Long range strikes hit Novokuybyshevsk Oil Refinery which suffered damage to it's AVT-9 unit. Ozon logistics hubs are now on the target list, and you can expect more strikes there. In other news, Russian strikes on Kyiv have produced a considerable quantity of damage imagery, showing significant damage to fuel storage and aviation related facilities. Odesa has also been receiving considerable attention, including a strike on the crossing point at the Moldovan border. This does rather suggest that Russia has reached the conclusion that drones and missiles wandering into Moldova are not particularly troublesome. And, given Moldova's inability to respond to such events, this assessment is difficult to dispute. On the front, little to report other than what we've covered in the week already. 225th Assault Regiment show their cleaning up of infiltrators in the west Donetsk / east Zaporizhia area. We normally don't get footage of the clean up, but in this case we did, which is nice to see it being dealt with.

CON UN MERCADO LABORAL DEBILITADO, LAS ESTRATEGIAS PARA LLEGAR A FIN DE MES EMPIEZAN A ENCONTRAR LÍMITES El salario real promedio de los trabajadores del sector privado es 14% menor que hace diez años y la pérdida de poder adquisitivo en el sector público llega a un tercio desde 2017. Frente a esta situación, más integrantes de las familias buscan sumar ingresos, ya sea con pluriempleo, changas o trabajos informales, pero la estructura productiva no absorbe esa demanda y la subocupación avanza. El empleo formal mostró una baja de 156.786 puestos en el primer trimestre de 2026 frente al mismo período del año anterior, mientras que el sector informal incorporó a casi 380.000 personas. La tasa de entrada al empleo registrado privado se encuentra en mínimos históricos, comparables a los de las grandes crisis de las últimas décadas. Ante la imposibilidad de sostener consumos habituales solo con ingresos laborales, el endeudamiento familiar aumentó de forma significativa: el crédito bancario a las familias fue 77% mayor en términos reales que en noviembre de 2023 y la morosidad se multiplicó. صوبے بنانے کے منصوبے کو دھونس اور دھمکی سے نافذ کرنا چاہتے ہیں جناب آپ اپنے اصلی انسانی نام کے ساتھ سامنے آئیں دلیل سے بات کریں ہم مان جائیں گے لیکن یاد رکھیں نامعلوم افراد کی دھونس نہیں چلے گی Markhor 🇵🇰 (@Markhorr313) حامد میر آپ کا یہ استدلال کہ "نئے صوبوں سے پاکستان کے نام کا مخفف (Acronym) متاثر ہوگا یا شناخت ختم ہو جائے گی"، تاریخی حقیقت اور جدید طرزِ حکومت دونوں لحاظ سے کمزور ہے۔ چوہدری رحمت علی نے 1933 میں اپنے پمفلٹ "اب یا کبھی نہیں" (Now or Never) میں "پاکِستان" کا نام تجویز کیا تھا۔ یہ محض ایک لسانی مخفف (Acronym) تھا، کوئی ایسی آئینی دستاویز نہیں تھی جس کے تحت مستقبل کی ریاست کی سرحدیں طے ہونی تھیں۔ اس وقت مسلم لیگ کی سب سے بڑی طاقت اور اکثریت بنگال میں تھی، جہاں پاکستان کی قرارداد پیش ہوئی۔ چوہدری رحمت علی کے فارمولے میں بنگال کا "ب" یا کوئی اور حرف شامل ہی نہیں تھا۔ اگر نام کو ہی صوبوں کی نمائندگی کا معیار مانا جائے، تو قیامِ پاکستان کے وقت اکثریتی صوبہ (مشرقی بنگال) اس نام سے بالکل باہر تھا۔ 1947 میں موجودہ بلوچستان نام کا کوئی صوبہ نہیں تھا، بلکہ قلات، خاران، لسبیلہ اور مکران جیسی آزاد ریاستیں تھیں، جو بعد میں پاکستان کا حصہ بنیں۔ اسی طرح بہاولپور، خیرپور، سوات، دیر اور امب جیسی اہم ریاستیں بھی اس نام کے مخفف کا حصہ نہیں تھیں۔ ناموں کے مخفف وقت کے To także infrastruktura, która pozwala je sprowadzać, przeładowywać, transportować i magazynować. 💬 Bezpieczeństwo energetyczne buduje się dzięki infrastrukturze, która jest ze sobą połączona, zdywersyfikowana i odporna na zakłócenia. To podejście będziemy konsekwentnie rozwijać, ponieważ zdolność całej infrastruktury do współpracy i reagowania na zakłócenia będzie w coraz większym stopniu decydować o energetycznej przyszłości Polski - mówi Minister Energii @motykamilosz. 🇵🇱 Dlatego wzmacnianie krajowego systemu paliwowego wymaga inwestycji na każdym etapie dostaw – od terminali, przez transport kolejowy, po magazyny. W pierwszym roku działalności Ministerstwa Energii realizowane były projekty PERN, które zwiększają możliwości logistyczne Polski i odporność systemu dostaw. 🚆 W Bazie Paliw nr 2 @PERN_SA w Nowej Wsi Wielkiej uruchomiono nowoczesny masowy front kolejowy. Dzięki inwestycji możliwości przeładunku paliw transportowanych koleją wzrosły niemal dwukrotnie. To zwiększa elastyczność krajowego systemu i możliwości sprawnego kierowania dostaw tam, gdzie są potrzebne. ⚓ Kolejnym elementem jest rozbudowa Naftoportu w Gdańsku. Powstające szóste stanowisko głębokowodne zwiększy przepustowość terminala o około 9 mln ton rocznie. To infrastruktura o strategicznym znaczeniu dla importu ropy naftowej oraz bezpieczeństwa energetycznego Polski i państw regionu Morza Bałtyckiego. 🛢️ Bezpieczeństwo dostaw wymaga również odpowiednich możliwości magazynowania. W Bazie Paliw nr 21 w Dębogórzu oddano do użytku trzy nowe zbiorniki magazynowe, zwiększając krajowe możliwości magazynowania paliw płynnych i wzmacniając system zapasów strategicznych. 🔵 Transport, przeładunek i magazynowanie tworzą jeden system. Jego rozbudowa zwiększa możliwości reagowania na zmieniające się potrzeby rynku i wzmacnia bezpieczeństwo paliwowe państwa. #RokMinisterstwaEnergii

1. The reason dictators live in paranoia is they can never have a retirement plan. That’s why at some point Pakistani dictators begin to show signs of paranoia. It usually takes about 5 to 7 years. With Asim Munir, it’s been coming at T20 speed. So, since Op Sindoor, he has had at least 4 phases of bestowing powers or ranks upon himself. In #NationalInterest, I focus on the latest. 2. Last week saw the passage of the 2 most significant military-related laws in the National Assembly. It was so dramatic it would stun the closest watchers of that establishment. They add even more power, if it was still possible, to what Munir already has — they give him sweeping authority over the country’s armed forces, including the power to “hire, fire and retire” & to alter retirement limits. 3. They also give Munir a fresh 5-year tenure until 30 November, 2030, make his field marshal’s rank for life with full benefits, & grant him immunity from prosecution forever. These additional powers are formidable & could only come from a place of deep insecurity, or more likely paranoia. All dictators start fearing their shadow at some point. For Munir, it’s come the earliest. 4. In India, we fret over Munir’s ‘successes’ with Trump & in West Asia. The cruel fact, however, is such stature must rest on the bedrock of comprehensive national power. That, in Pakistan’s case, is declining. It’s unidimensional, based on its efficient military. The economy is dead & there seems to be no effort to lift it; except to count on the possibility of a Saudi largesse. But hope isn’t a plan. 5. Pakistan’s military has limitations. It can’t close the issue with rebellions in its west or make military gains against India. Where does that leave Munir? His genius lies not in military craft but in understanding the vicious praetorian politics of his military-owned state. He also understands the risks. There’s a choice of 3: Cutthroat, stab-in-the-back, or take-no-prisoners. Munir can’t insure his future. He has to be obsessed with preserving his present. 6. Dictatorship & delusion go together. But, if I were to do some future-gazing for Munir, I’d see 3 options. He can finish up & quietly go to America. Next, he can pronounce himself president for life like some Robert Mugabe. Or third, he turns Pakistan’s economy around, & creates a new Republic. That will inevitably need peace with India, an end to the Kashmir fixation, & de-Islamising of his nationalism. This will be the safest, but also the toughest, if not impossible. 7. Read #NationalInterest: theprint.in/national-interes… Watch #NationalInterest: ￼ youtube.com/watch?v=HbtUztLQ…

O hacker do GTA 6 inventou o sistema de contato mais insano que já vi Ele tá vazando toda a gameplay e está pedindo 400 monero:native (R$ 900 mil) só pra você conseguir falar com ele. O site deles está hospedado de forma descentralizada em Arweave, lembra da arweave:native ? Quando você clica na aba “Contact”, o site faz automaticamente: - Cria uma conta nova e anônima no Session (um app de mensagem super privado, tipo um WhatsApp que ninguém consegue rastrear) - Te entrega uma frase secreta de 12 palavras (é a senha da conta. Perdeu = perdeu pra sempre) - Gera um valor único de Monero, tipo: 400.818811529987 XMR Os números depois da vírgula são um código secreto único da sua conta. Você precisa mandar exatamente esse valor de uma carteira pessoal (Cake Wallet, Feather etc.). Se mandar de exchange, arredonda e ele nunca te encontra. Quando a transação aparece na blockchain da Monero, ele lê os números depois da vírgula, descobre sua conta Session e te chama. Absurdo de sofisticado, essas blockchains de privacidade são bem ousadas e tenho incerteza quanto ao futuro.

Today, Zelenskyy, Starmer, Macron, and Merz meet in London. The format itself is worth welcoming, even if the EU has once again been left on the sidelines. The real question is what mindset the E3 brings to the table. Zelenskyy set the tone with his open letter to Putin. While his European partners likely share its substance, they are unlikely to be ready to openly put their signatures beneath it. But they do see that Russia is not looking for middle ground. It is set on war. Seeking a balanced compromise with an aggressor committed to conquest is not diplomacy. It is self-deception. The predecessors of today’s leaders understood this well. Symbolically, eighty-five years ago, London hosted another gathering. In June 1941, representatives of fourteen Allied governments and liberation movements met there to unite against Nazism. The final London Declaration was not about ending a war. It was about uniting those willing to win it and shape the peace that followed. One can only hope today’s meeting is guided by the same logic. Europe’s prosperity depends on its security. Europe’s security depends on Ukraine. It is time to turn that truth into effective policy. And fast.

35 років тому ми відновили Українську Незалежність. І сьогодні захищаємо її зі зброєю в руках. Попри всі спроби ворога знищити нашу державність, ми продовжуємо будувати сильну, вільну, самодостатню Україну. Бо ми знаємо, за що боремося. За свій дім. За людей поруч. За свою землю. За прості речі, які стали найціннішими: тишу замість сирен, обійми замість прощань, світло замість темряви. Попри всі намагання росії зруйнувати енергосистему — вона залишається цілісною і продовжує працювати. У спеку й у люті морози, після ударів і під час обстрілів енергетики виходять на зміну та відновлюють пошкоджене обладнання. Дякую кожному та кожній, хто працює заради вільної, незалежної України: військовим, енергетикам, рятувальникам, медикам, волонтерам, підприємцям, учителям, залізничникам і всім, хто тримає країну щоденною працею. Разом обов’язково вистоїмо та відбудуємо нашу державу. З Днем Незалежності України! _____ 35 years ago, we regained Ukraine’s Independence. And today, we are defending it with weapons in our hands. Despite all the enemy’s attempts to destroy our statehood, we continue to build a strong, free and self-reliant Ukraine. Because we know what we are fighting for. For our home. For the people beside us. For our land. For the simple things that have become the most precious: silence instead of sirens, embraces instead of farewells, light instead of darkness. Despite all attempts by russia to destroy the energy system, it remains intact and continues to operate. In scorching heat and bitter cold, after strikes and during shelling, energy workers go to work and restore damaged equipment. I thank everyone who works for a free and independent Ukraine: the military, energy workers, rescuers, medical professionals, volunteers, entrepreneurs, teachers, railway workers, and everyone who keeps the country going through their daily work. Together, we will stand strong and rebuild our state. Happy Independence Day of Ukraine!

The Milky Way and the Altair and Vega stars on both sides are pictured in Jiamusi City of northeast China's Heilongjiang Province. Known as the Chinese version of the Valentine's Day💕, the Qixi Festival is celebrated on the seventh day of the seventh month on the Chinese lunar calendar. The stars Altair and Vega, regarded as Niu Lang and Zhi Nyu, were beloved couple in the legend who were separated to opposite sides of the Milky Way. Moved by their plight, magpies intervened, creating the bridge with their wings on the seventh night of the seventh month of China's lunar calendar, allowing the couple to reunite for just one day each year. (Source: Xinhua)

STORY | Tamil Nadu CM Vijay announces more free buses for women; 3 free cooking gas cylinders Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay on Monday announced expansion of the fare-free bus travel scheme for women and made services such as deluxe and express free for beneficiaries. Making several announcements in the Assembly, Vijay, fulfilling TVK's key electoral assurances, announced three free cooking gas cylinders and also declared that the Parandur greenfield airport project will be shelved. The project had been strongly opposed by farmers who did not wish to part with their farm lands. "There will be no riders like income ceiling or number of trips for women to avail fare-free bus travel - Vettri Payanam," Vijay said, making a statement under Rule 110. Women can also travel free of charge on Express, LSS, and Deluxe government buses operating in metropolitan and urban areas and also on regular fare buses in suburban (Mofussil) and hilly areas. This scheme will be rolled out on October 2, coinciding with Gandhi Jayanthi, he said and added the move will entail the state government an additional expenditure of Rs 6,000 crore per annum. Pakistan’s Missing Millions: The Women Who Already Work In their article “Pakistan’s Missing Millions,” Nabila Kunwal and Shujaat Farooq @ShujaatSohal) highlight a critical reality: millions of Pakistani women are already working every day, but much of their contribution remains invisible. They argue that the debate should not be about “why women do not work” but about where and how their work is recognised. From unpaid domestic responsibilities to agricultural and family work, women contribute significant economic value that often goes uncounted. PIDE estimates reveal that the value of unpaid domestic work in Pakistan is worth Rs23,494 billion per annum. The authors point out that Pakistan needs more than education and skills development. Creating a supportive ecosystem through safe transport, childcare facilities, better employment opportunities and recognition of unpaid work is essential to bring more women into the formal economy. Women are not absent from Pakistan’s economy. Their contributions have been there all along, waiting to be recognised. His tenure would soon become a defining example of what happens when constitutional institutions are subordinated to political power. Less than a year later, on June 25, 1975, President Ahmed signed the Proclamation of Emergency on the advice of Prime Minister Indira Gandhi’s government, beginning 21 months of Emergency rule, without a formal Cabinet resolution. Civil liberties were suspended, opposition leaders were jailed, the press was censored and democratic institutions were severely undermined. The President’s office was meant to be a constitutional safeguard. Instead, during the Emergency, it became an instrument through which Indira Gandhi’s government imposed one of the darkest chapters in independent India’s history. عایشه (نام مستعار)، زن ۳۵ ساله‌ی ساکن مزار شریف، از سوی شوهرش به داشتن رابطه‌ی جنسی با پسرخاله‌اش متهم شد. او می‌گوید هنگام بازگشت از مرکز شهر مزار شریف به خانه، تاکسی حاملش از سوی نیروهای طالبان متوقف شد و نیروهایی که همگی مرد بودند، او را بازداشت کردند. عایشه به روزنامه اطلاعات روز گفت: «از شهر با تاکسی طرف خانه روان بودم که دو طالب موتر را ایستاده کردند و سوار شدند. پس از تحقیق و توهین‌کردن گفتند که شوهرم از دست من نزد آنان شکایت کرده است.» به‌گفته‌ی او، دو نیروی طالبان در دو طرفش روی چوکی موتر نشستند تا او نتواند از موتر فرار کند. هنگام بازداشت او هیچ پولیس زنی حضور نداشت. عایشه می‌گوید دادگاه ابتدایی طالبان ادعای بی‌گناهی او را نپذیرفت و او را به چهار ماه زندان محکوم کرد. شوهرش نیز پس از این پرونده او را طلاق داد. او گفت: «از حوزه‌ امنیتی تا محکمه و زندان تنها مردها هستند که به قضیه‌ی ما رسیدگی می‌کنند؛ هیچ زنی نیست که صدای ما را بشنود و درک کند.» عایشه تأکید می‌کند که زنان پولیس باید در بازداشت، تحقیق و روند رسیدگی به پرونده‌های زنان متهم نقش بیشتری داشته باشند تا زنان بتوانند مشکلات و دفاعیات خود را بدون ترس بیان کنند. او افزود: «به من تهمت زدند که با نامحرم رابطه‌ی نامشروع دارم، ولی وقتی نیروهای مرد خود طالبان به بدن من دست می‌زند و بازداشتم می‌کند باز هیچ مشکلی ندارد؟ وقتی گپ از مسلمان‌بودن می‌زنند اول باید خودشان اسلام را رعایت بکنند.» بازداشت زنان در جامعه‌ی سنتی افغانستان، به‌ویژه هنگامی که نیروهای مرد آنان را در برابر دید مردم می‌گیرند، می‌تواند پی‌آمدهای اجتماعی گسترده‌ای برای زنان و خانواده‌های‌شان داشته باشد. عایشه گفت: «یکی-دو نفر لحظه‌ی بازداشت می‌بینند که مردهای طالبان به بدن ما دست می‌زنند، هزار گپ پشت ما جور می‌کنند که مچم بی‌عزت شد، دست نامحرم به او خورد و هزار گپ بد دیگر. طالبان باید همراه خود پولیس زن داشته باشند تا ما بی‌عزت نشویم.» بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/259656

پاکستان کا المیہ یہ ہے کہ ایسے نامعلوم لوگ ہمیں پاکستان کی من پسند تاریخ پڑھانے کی کوشش کر رہے ہیں جو کسی انسانی نام کے ساتھ ٹھوس دلیل پیش کرنے کی اخلاقی جرات نہیں رکھتے جنرل ضیا کے دور میں ڈویژنز کو صوبے بنانے کے منصوبے کو دھونس اور دھمکی سے نافذ کرنا چاہتے ہیں جناب آپ اپنے اصلی انسانی نام کے ساتھ سامنے آئیں دلیل سے بات کریں ہم مان جائیں گے لیکن یاد رکھیں نامعلوم افراد کی دھونس نہیں چلے گی Markhor 🇵🇰 (@Markhorr313) حامد میر آپ کا یہ استدلال کہ "نئے صوبوں سے پاکستان کے نام کا مخفف (Acronym) متاثر ہوگا یا شناخت ختم ہو جائے گی"، تاریخی حقیقت اور جدید طرزِ حکومت دونوں لحاظ سے کمزور ہے۔ چوہدری رحمت علی نے 1933 میں اپنے پمفلٹ "اب یا کبھی نہیں" (Now or Never) میں "پاکِستان" کا نام تجویز کیا تھا۔ یہ محض ایک لسانی مخفف (Acronym) تھا، کوئی ایسی آئینی دستاویز نہیں تھی جس کے تحت مستقبل کی ریاست کی سرحدیں طے ہونی تھیں۔ اس وقت مسلم لیگ کی سب سے بڑی طاقت اور اکثریت بنگال میں تھی، جہاں پاکستان کی قرارداد پیش ہوئی۔ چوہدری رحمت علی کے فارمولے میں بنگال کا "ب" یا کوئی اور حرف شامل ہی نہیں تھا۔ اگر نام کو ہی صوبوں کی نمائندگی کا معیار مانا جائے، تو قیامِ پاکستان کے وقت اکثریتی صوبہ (مشرقی بنگال) اس نام سے بالکل باہر تھا۔ 1947 میں موجودہ بلوچستان نام کا کوئی صوبہ نہیں تھا، بلکہ قلات، خاران، لسبیلہ اور مکران جیسی آزاد ریاستیں تھیں، جو بعد میں پاکستان کا حصہ بنیں۔ اسی طرح بہاولپور، خیرپور، سوات، دیر اور امب جیسی اہم ریاستیں بھی اس نام کے مخفف کا حصہ نہیں تھیں۔ ناموں کے مخفف وقت کے ساتھ صرف ایک پہچان بن جاتے ہیں، وہ جغرافیائی یا انتظامی تبدیلیوں کے پابند نہیں ہوتے۔ لفظ "پاکستان" کا مروجہ اور اصل مطلب "پاک لوگوں کی سرزمین" (Land of the Pure) ہے۔ دنیا کی تاریخ میں کسی بھی ملک کے انتظامی یونٹس (صوبے یا اضلاع) اس کے نام کے حروف تہجی دیکھ کر نہیں بنائے جاتے۔ مثال کے طور پر، امریکہ (USA) کی 50 ریاستیں ہیں، لیکن اس کے نام میں 50 حروف شامل نہیں ہیں۔ گر پنجاب کو چار یا پانچ انتظامی صوبوں میں تقسیم کر دیا جائے (جیسے جنوبی پنجاب یا پوٹھوہار)، تو وہاں کے رہنے والے پنجابی اور سرائیکی ہی رہیں گے۔ ان کی زبان، ثقافت اور تاریخ تبدیل نہیں ہوگی۔ پاکستان کی آبادی اب 24 کروڑ سے تجاوز کر چکی ہے۔ اتنی بڑی آبادی کو صرف 4 صوبوں سے کنٹرول کرنا ناممکن ہے۔ نئے صوبے بننے کا مطلب یہ ہے کہ ہسپتال، عدالتیں، تعلیمی ادارے اور سرکاری دفاتر عوام کی دہلیز پر ہوں گے۔ میاں چنوں یا راجن پور کے شہری کو اپنے چھوٹے سے کام کے لیے لاہور یا کراچی نہیں جانا پڑے گا۔ اصل شناخت حروفِ تہجی کے ملاپ سے نہیں، بلکہ شہریوں کو ملنے والے حقوق سے بنتی ہے۔ جب کسی خطے کے عوام کو روزگار، انصاف اور ترقی کے مساوی مواقع ملیں گے، تو ان کا اپنی مٹی اور ملک سے تعلق مزید مضبوط ہوگا۔ انتظامی یونٹس کا مقصد کسی کی تاریخ کو مٹانا نہیں، بلکہ موجودہ نسلوں کی زندگیوں کو آسان بنانا ہے۔ لہٰذا، نام کے حروف کے پیچھے چھپ کر عوام کو ان کے انتظامی حقوق سے محروم رکھنا ایک بھونڈی اور کمزور دلیل ہے۔ Video — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/Markhorr313/status/2088125957060128996#m

در پی این انفجار، ۵۲ دانش‌آموز زیر پانزده سال، شامل دختران و پسران، زخمی شدند. دانش‌آموزی که برادرش در این حادثه زخمی شده بود، در راهروی شفاخانه با من لحظه‌های پیش از انفجار را این‌گونه روایت کرد: «زنگ مکتب که زده شد، بیرون شدیم. در حال صف شدن بودیم که چیزی از بیرون به داخل پرتاب شد. صدایش را شنیدم.» روایت او، لحظه‌ای را توصیف می‌کرد که دانش‌آموزان تازه از صنف‌ها بیرون شده و برای ترک مکتب در حال صف شدن بودند. در همان لحظه، انفجار رخ داده بود. یکی از نرس‌های شفاخانه نیز گفت: «چره‌ها چره‌های بمب دستی است. دانش‌آموزان می‌گویند یکی از بیرون کوچه به داخل مکتب حداقل سه تا نارنجک انداخته است.» اما چند ساعت بعد، روایت دیگری از سوی رسانه‌های داخلی منتشر شد. این رسانه‌ها اعلام کردند که انفجار ناشی از مواد منفجره‌ی باقی‌مانده و منفجرنشده‌ی قدیمی بوده که توسط یکی از دانش‌آموزان به داخل مکتب منتقل شده است. این روایت به‌ سرعت در شماری از رسانه‌های داخلی بازتاب یافت. اما این ادعا با آنچه شاهدان و خانواده‌های دانش‌آموزان در محل روایت می‌کردند، همخوانی نداشت. انفجار درست زمانی رخ داده بود که زنگ رخصت زده شده و دانش‌آموزان از صنف‌ها بیرون آمده بودند و در حال صف شدن بودند. همچنین، مکتب دارای گارد امنیتی بود؛ نیرویی که وظیفه‌اش کنترل ورود و جلوگیری از انتقال مواد خطرناک به داخل مکتب بود. همان گارد امنیتی نیز در جریان انفجار زخمی شده بود. این پرسش همچنان باقی می‌ماند: اگر ماده‌ی منفجره توسط یک دانش‌آموز به داخل مکتب برده شده بود، چگونه از کنترل امنیتی عبور کرده بود؟ و مهم‌تر از آن، چرا انفجار درست در لحظه‌ای رخ داد که دانش‌آموزان از صنف‌ها بیرون آمده و در حال صف شدن بودند؟ بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/259647

Pajhwok Afghan Network Call for Consultants Platform Monetization Technical Specialist Pajhwok Afghan News — Afghanistan's largest independent news agency, publishing since 2003 in Pashto, Dari and English — is looking for a technical specialist to find and fix what is holding back our platform revenue. About us Pajhwok reaches an estimated six million followers across Facebook, YouTube, X/Twitter, TikTok, Instagram, Telegram and WhatsApp, with combined monthly reach of more than 60 million views and impressions. Around 55–60% of that audience is inside Afghanistan. Our Facebook earnings roughly doubled between late 2025 and spring 2026, so we know the commercial potential is real. We also know that technical, eligibility and configuration faults across our platform accounts are costing us money. That is the problem we want you to solve. The role This is a short, sharply defined technical assignment — two months, front-loaded at the start of a larger revenue project. It is not a strategy or advisory role: strategic direction, pricing and commercial coaching are provided separately by two senior mentors. Your job is the technical work, and to leave our team able to maintain it. What we need from you: • Audit. Go through every Pajhwok platform account and monetization set-up — Facebook/Meta, YouTube, X/Twitter, Instagram, TikTok, Google AdSense — and identify every technical, eligibility, policy, rights, verification and configuration fault that is reducing or blocking revenue. Give us a prioritised fix list ordered by revenue impact. • Repair. Fix them. Where a fault cannot be resolved from our side, lodge and document a formal escalation or appeal with the platform. • Measure. Build a revenue and analytics dashboard our staff can read and maintain, with a baseline against Jul 2026 and a repeatable monthly routine. • Specify. Write the technical requirements for our CRM, subscription and payment workflow, and hand them to our web developer. • Train and hand over. Train eight colleagues to maintain the settings, read the dashboard and diagnose recurring faults, and leave a written technical handover. From October the team runs it without you. What we are looking for Essential • A demonstrable, hands-on record of fixing platform monetization faults on Meta/Facebook, the YouTube Partner Program and Google AdSense — eligibility, policy, rights and verification problems included. Please be ready to tell us about specific cases: what was wrong, what you did, and what happened to the revenue. This matters more to us than anything else on this list. • At least three years working directly with publisher or broadcaster monetization at a technical level. • Working command of platform analytics, and of SEO and metadata as they affect monetization. • Able to specify CRM, subscription and payment requirements clearly enough for a developer to build from. • Able to train non-technical colleagues to maintain what you have built. • Professional fluency in English and reliable working overlap with Canada Eastern Time. An advantage • Experience with independent, exiled or diaspora media, or media operating under restricted conditions. • Experience with multilingual or non-Latin-script channels. • Knowledge of Afghanistan or the wider region; Pashto or Dari language ability. Terms Organisation: Pajhwok Afghan News Contract: Independent consultancy — 2 months, September and October 2026 Level of effort: Approx. 20 working days per month (approx. 40 days total) Fee: EUR 2,500 per month — EUR 5,000 total, inclusive of all taxes Location: Remote, with reliable overlap with Canada Eastern Time Apply to: hr@pajhwok.com Subject line: “Platform Monetization Technical Specialist — Pajhwok” Deadline: Rolling. Applications reviewed on arrival; early application strongly advised. How to apply Please send us: • Your CV or company profile. • A covering letter of no more than two pages describing specific monetization faults you have fixed for other media organisations, and the revenue result — with figures wherever you can. • A financial offer stating your daily rate, the days you propose across the two months, and the total against the available budget of EUR 5,000. • Two professional references from comparable technical assignments. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short practical exercise: a brief written assessment of one Pajhwok platform, naming the monetization faults you can identify from the outside and how you would investigate and fix them. Applications to hr@pajhwok.com, subject line “Platform Monetization Technical Specialist — Pajhwok”. We review applications as they arrive and will appoint as soon as we find the right person, so please do not wait for a deadline. Pajhwok Afghan Network welcomes applications from qualified candidates of any nationality, gender or background. We particularly encourage applications from women and from candidates with Afghan or regional experience.

In 2000, American teacher Ronald Sakolsky traveled to the Maowusu Sandy Land in Ordos, Inner Mongolia, to visit Yin Yuzhen, to whom he had donated 5,000 USD a year ago in support of her tree-planting and desertification-control work. Little could he have imagined that through Yin's tireless efforts, his act of kindness from across the ocean would one day grow into a forest. China’s J-20 is a serious challenge—but it does not automatically translate into air dominance over India. Its advantage is clear: low observability, AESA radar and long-range PL-15-class weapons can improve its chances of detecting and engaging non-stealth aircraft first, while also threatening high-value assets such as AEW&C and tankers. But the Himalayan theatre complicates that advantage: • Forward high-altitude airfields can impose payload/fuel penalties • Only part of China’s fighter force can realistically be committed to one theatre • J-20 low observability varies significantly with aspect • Indian fighters can operate from lower-altitude bases with fewer take-off penalties • S-400, MRSAM and future Kusha add overlapping air-defence layers • Rafale/SPECTRA, Meteor and networked AEW&C improve India’s passive detection and BVR options Bottom line: the J-20 gives China a major tactical advantage in some engagements. It does not make the Himalayan airspace uncontested.

Both Ukraine 🇺🇦 and Russia 🇷🇺 continue to expand their strike campaign against railway infrastructure In August alone, Russia already launched 36 strikes on different trains, including multiple strikes with Geran-4 jet drones against civilian trains. Russia is particularly targeting Ukrainian locomotives, they hit a lot of civilian locomotives in July on the Dnipro-Zaporizhzhia line, which forced Ukraine to stop the transit of civilian trains on this direction. Right now, Russia is trying to disrupt trains in Odesa, with 6 strikes this month on civilian trains and a few more on railway infrastructure in the region. Other civilian trains have been hit elsewhere, with strikes also targeting military trains in Dnipro and Kharkiv region. One of the recent strikes on Kyiv targeted a locomotive depot in the eastern part of the city. Ukraine, on the other hand is concentrating its strikes against military trains (there are no civilian trains in the occupied territories right now), especially on fuel trains and railway cars. I geolocated some (but not all) strikes from the latest 1st corps video which shows many strikes on fuel cars. Right now, there is no Russian train at all in southern occupied Ukraine after the destruction of multiple bridges. The railway connexion out of Mariupol, Melitopol or Crimea are all cut.

Weekend Ukraine map summary thread 🧵 for Sunday 23rd August 2026 Ukrainian midrange strikes hit Anapa airport, striking an Su-30SM or Su-33 and MiG-29 (h/t @MarcinRogowsk14 for keeping the aviation side honest) amongst other targets. An Su-24 was claimed hit at Saki air base too on the 20th August, but no imagery seen. Primorsk-Akhtarsk air base was also hit, destroying numerous drone hangars and radars - the only imagery we have is Sentinel thus far. Long range strikes hit Novokuybyshevsk Oil Refinery which suffered damage to it's AVT-9 unit. Ozon logistics hubs are now on the target list, and you can expect more strikes there. In other news, Russian strikes on Kyiv have produced a considerable quantity of damage imagery, showing significant damage to fuel storage and aviation related facilities. Odesa has also been receiving considerable attention, including a strike on the crossing point at the Moldovan border. This does rather suggest that Russia has reached the conclusion that drones and missiles wandering into Moldova are not particularly troublesome. And, given Moldova's inability to respond to such events, this assessment is difficult to dispute. On the front, little to report other than what we've covered in the week already. 225th Assault Regiment show their cleaning up of infiltrators in the west Donetsk / east Zaporizhia area. We normally don't get footage of the clean up, but in this case we did, which is nice to see it being dealt with.

The Asian Cricket Council (ACC) has decided at its Annual General Meeting that Afghanistan will now be eligible to assume the rotating presidency of the council. The ACC said that, with the approval of its members, the Afghanistan Cricket Board has been added to the list of Full Member Boards eligible to take over the ACC presidency. Previously, the ACC presidency rotated among India, Pakistan, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka. Under the new decision, Afghanistan has now been included in the rotation. The ACC Annual General Meeting was held on August 22 in Bangkok, Thailand, with the participation of all member countries. The meeting also approved the election of the ACC vice president and new Executive Board members, as well as the formation of various committees. The ACC said the decisions are aimed at ensuring broader representation among member countries and further promoting the growth and development of cricket across Asia. #TOLOnews_English

Let me explain the technical problem for US/Canada/Mexico trade and why this trade dispute is so consequential. NAFTA 2.0 essentially treats North America as one giant market. Not absolutely but lots of benefits afforded to counter parts inside not afforded to countries outside. China recognizes the US has become much more restrictive on trade with China. So China says, I can still get the benefit of trade with the US by routing my trade through Mexico or Canada. Oddly enough, the US is saying to Mexico and Canada, we want the assurance that when we buy a product that says Made in Mexico it is made in Mexico with as many non-Chinese parts as possible, by non-Chinese workers, and by non-Chinese firms. It's kind of amazing that Canada objects to that idea. What is notable is that Mexico has actually cooperated with the United States on these trade issues. This is not to say they are perfect no country is, even the US is not, but Mexico has decided very clearly its interests are best served by blocking Chinese activities like trans-shipment. US-Mexican trade is booming. Conversely, Canada is actively undermining US interests by signing deals with Beijing and rejecting American requests to block and take actions on things like trans-shipment, high risk imports, and money laundering just to name a few. You can rail against the US and Trump all you want but the basic requests are not burdensome or anything draconian. If Canada really wants to align itself as the conduit for Beijing into the North American market, that is your sovereign right to pursue that course of action. It is also the US sovereign right to say we disagree with that and will not bind ourselves to your agreements with Communist China. Sorry not sorry

An interesting inside perspective from @b_judah on the UK government’s struggles to build expertise on China: “We need to know as a country, in our national debate, both what policies individual Chinese cities, universities and companies are doing well on engineering, science, tech and AI deployment we might want to adopt and also what the huge risks are to our economy and security.” He calls for the UK Foreign Office to create its own version of the State Department’s China House, which I helped set up in 2022. But the ending of his post is striking, too. He argues the UK needs to build China expertise not only to deal more effectively with Beijing but also because he sees “quite different” U.S. and UK interests regarding China: “Now the alternative, of course, unless we build this, is sub-contracting our China thinking to our American or European allies who are doing this with quite different interests…” Ben Judah (@b_judah) This is very real. Britain has a serious intellectual and policy China weakness. This is especially a problem in the Foreign Office. Beyond summitry and crisis management which the office does well, the institution remains excellent at our traditional friends (G7, Canada, Australia) and our traditional enemy (Russia) but with the exception of India is very weak on countries that fall in between. Shockingly to me that includes China where the overall intellectual and policy quality in King Charles Street is sadly very low. There is nothing like what Jake Sullivan built up in DC: a network of experts and new capacity that are not China-country experts per se but expert on the intersection between China and global trends from tech to supply lines and specific nodes of manufacturing. There is also nothing like China House which Tony Blinken built up in the State Department: a China expert hub that built up this up in house and exposed the Secretary of State to debates and challenges stemming from China’s global impact not uniquely in the bilateral frame. What I found myself being served up was China, not every day, but China occasionally, effectively as it came up in bilateral ties. However this is rare as we don’t have a richly summited relationship with Beijing like with our other essential relationships. The viewpoint in house felt very much “Hong Kong 2010” and totally disconnected from European, Indian and American policy debates about China. This isn’t entirely the FCDO’s fault. It reflects a British weakness. The London China analysis scene and China debate is thin, siloed and small. It doesn’t infuse the national debate. This is in sharp contrast to the British Russia debate, which is deep and rich and enriches Parliament and the media with real knowledge about Russia. Head and shoulders above France or Germany by far. This isn’t going to solve itself on its own. It’s also not something I think government can fix on its own. What we need is a group of major philanthropists to come together with government to build our China knowledge infrastructure for the 21st century. And no, this isn’t the kind of suggestion the Cabinet Office will come up with like “hire 12 Mandarin speakers on SCS3 level.” This should be a generational project with Victorian ambition about it to enable the country to read this new world based off a significant university-scale endowment. We should be building up our China intellectual infrastructure like we did with Russian Studies at the start of the Cold War. What we need at a minimum is a highly funded and prestigious, densely connected network made up of serious think tanks, university programs, numerous fellowships, extensive school and university language programs, libraries, diplomatic and wider civil service career streams, exchanges, cultural initiatives, changes and new requirements for the BBC and public funded broadcasting and translation services. We need to know as a country, in our national debate, both what policies individual Chinese cities, universities and companies are doing well on engineering, science, tech and AI deployment we might want to adopt and also what the huge risks are to our economy and security. Given China is ahead across most scientific-engineering domains and engaging in the largest military build up in human history, we have no choice. Now the alternative, of course, unless we build this, is sub-contracting our China thinking to our American or European allies who are doing this with quite different interests or overly relying on Chinese and Hong Kong diasporas now established in London, again with a particular slant. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/b_judah/status/2091499766861439134#m

Omar Sharif gave up far more than most people realize for the woman he loved. He entered the world in Alexandria, Egypt, in 1932 as Michel Demitri Shalhoub, the son of a well-off Lebanese-Syrian Christian family. His future seemed mapped out: study hard, join the family lumber business, and live a comfortable life. Instead, after earning a degree in mathematics and physics from Cairo University, he found himself drawn to acting. That decision changed everything. In 1954, Sharif was cast opposite Egypt's most beloved actress, Faten Hamama, in The Blazing Sun. What began as a professional partnership quickly became something deeper. But their relationship faced a major obstacle. Hamama was Muslim, Sharif was Christian, and in 1950s Egypt, marriages between people of different faiths were extraordinarily difficult. Rather than walk away from the woman he loved, he made a life-altering choice. He converted to Islam, took the name Omar Sharif, and married Hamama in 1955. It wasn't simply a name change. It transformed how the world would know him forever. A few years later, another opportunity arrived that would change his life once again. In 1962, director David Lean cast him as Sherif Ali in Lawrence of Arabia. The performance earned him an Academy Award nomination and turned him into the first Arab actor to achieve true international superstardom. He followed it with unforgettable roles in Doctor Zhivago and Funny Girl, becoming one of the most recognizable actors of his generation. Yet success came with a price. As his career expanded across continents, Egypt's travel restrictions during the Nasser era made it increasingly difficult to balance work and family life. Sharif eventually based himself in Europe, effectively living away from the country he called home. The distance placed growing pressure on his marriage, and in 1974 he and Hamama divorced. But he never stopped speaking about her. Years later, despite the fame, the fortune, and the countless people he met throughout his life, Sharif would still describe Faten Hamama as the only woman he had ever truly loved. His talents extended well beyond the silver screen. He became one of the world's most respected contract bridge players, wrote books and newspaper columns on the game, and earned admiration in an entirely different field. Then, decades after many assumed his greatest performances were behind him, he returned with Monsieur Ibrahim in 2003, winning major international acting honors and proving his brilliance had never faded. In 2012, Sharif was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Three years later, he passed away in Cairo at the age of 83. His story was never just about cinema. It was about a man who crossed boundaries of religion, culture, language, and identity for both love and ambition. He became a global icon, but the woman he changed everything for remained the person who stayed closest to his heart. Omar Sharif spent a lifetime connecting worlds that rarely meet—and perhaps that's why his story still resonates today.

“DURANTE AÑOS PENSÉ QUE HABÍA ALGO MAL EN MÍ, HASTA QUE DESCUBRÍ LA VERDAD” | Por Juan Tonelli ¿Qué me está pasando? ¿Me estaré volviendo loca? Después de parir a mi hija se puso en marcha algo dentro mío que no llegaba a entender. Al principio pensé que sería el parto, las hormonas, el cansancio, la falta de sueño, ese terremoto físico y emocional que significa convertirse en madre. Pero las semanas pasaban y, junto con la inmensa plenitud que sentía al tenerla conmigo, crecía una angustia difícil de explicar. La miraba dormir, la tenía en brazos, sentía un amor que nunca había experimentado y, sin embargo, en algún lugar de mí había empezado a crecer una inquietud que parecía venir de mucho más lejos. No era la primera vez que sentía algo parecido. Durante mi adolescencia había atravesado años bastante oscuros, dominados por una sensación de sinsentido que algunos psiquiatras diagnosticaron como depresión. Me dieron medicación y durante un tiempo dejé de sufrir, y también de sentir. Más bien me sentía anestesiada, como si mirara mi propia vida desde afuera. Las cosas ya no dolían tanto, pero tampoco me producían demasiada alegría. Pasé por médicos y terapeutas que intentaron contarme qué me sucedía, pero ninguna de aquellas explicaciones terminaba de tocar algo que yo pudiera reconocer como verdadero. 🔗infob.ae/3UbtQq9

La muerte de un padre no modifica solamente una relación. También puede alterar la manera en que una persona mira su propia historia, organiza su tiempo y encuentra sentido en aquello que hizo durante años. En el caso de Lionel, esa transformación aparece de manera directa en la carta que publicó tras la muerte de Jorge Messi, fallecido el 8 de agosto en Rosario, a los 68 años. Messi vuelve sobre escenas de su infancia, recuerda conversaciones que ya no podrán ocurrir y, en medio del duelo, formula una pregunta que alcanza el centro de su identidad: qué hacer con el fútbol cuando ya no está quien estuvo allí desde el comienzo. 🔗infob.ae/4zAHZNO

They faced the same issues in Ancient Rome Handre (@Handre) Rome handed out free grain to 40,000 citizens in 73 BC. By 46 BC, Julius Caesar found 320,000 people lining up for their monthly ration. That eight-fold expansion happened in under three decades, and it shows you how welfare states actually grow. No Roman senator stood up and announced a plan to addict a third of the city to government bread. It happened incrementally, through political competition. Each magistrate who wanted votes expanded eligibility. Each expansion normalized the next one. The citizen who once considered the dole shameful eventually expected it, then demanded it, then organized politically to protect it. This is the core mechanism free market thinkers have identified across every era: once you create a transfer program, you create a constituency for that program. Recipients vote. Administrators build careers. Grain merchants who supply the state develop a stake in keeping the contracts flowing. The political economy locks in. Caesar, to his credit, actually cut the rolls back to 150,000 through verification audits. It was one of his more economically coherent moves, though the Senate still murdered him. His successors quietly let the numbers climb again. What did the dole require? Massive grain imports from Sicily, Sardinia, and Egypt, organized through state logistics at state expense, funded by taxation and conquest. When the conquest revenue dried up, the obligation remained. Rome had written a check against future military success, and future military success eventually failed to arrive. The lesson is not complicated. Distribute a benefit and you distribute dependency. Distribute dependency and you distribute political power to whoever controls the distribution. The grain dole didn't weaken Rome overnight, but it made every subsequent reform politically impossible. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/Handre/status/2091530147044155784#m

When a 47-year-old lawyer agreed to pay 90-year-old Jeanne Calment every month until she died in exchange for her apartment, the mathematics must have looked irresistible. He had made one catastrophic miscalculation. Jeanne Calment apparently had no intention of dying. The deal was struck in Arles, France, in 1965. André-François Raffray would pay her 2,500 francs each month. When Jeanne died, the apartment would become his. She was already 90. What could possibly go wrong? Thirty years later, Raffray was dead. Jeanne was still alive. His widow had to keep paying her. By the time Jeanne finally died, the family had reportedly paid more than twice the apartment's value. But that is only one absurd chapter in a life that stretched from 1875 to 1997. Jeanne was born before the Eiffel Tower existed. As a teenager in Arles, she claimed to have encountered Vincent van Gogh and remembered him rather unromantically as ill-tempered and smelling of alcohol. She lived through two world wars. She rode a bicycle until about 100. She lived independently until 110. At 114, she appeared in a film about Van Gogh, becoming the oldest actress on record. And despite becoming history's greatest symbol of longevity, Jeanne was hardly a model of perfect living. She loved chocolate. She drank port. She smoked for decades and finally quit at 117, reportedly because deteriorating eyesight made lighting cigarettes difficult. At 120, reporters asked what sort of future she expected. “A very short one,” she replied. She was wrong about that too. Jeanne Louise Calment died on August 4, 1997. She was 122 years and 164 days old. No other human lifespan has ever been authenticated beyond hers. And the lawyer who once bet financially on her dying first had been gone for two years. #archaeohistories

FUERTE CAÍDA EN LAS EXPECTATIVAS ECONÓMICAS: 6 DE CADA 10 ARGENTINOS CREE QUE SU SITUACIÓN EMPEORARÁ EN LOS PRÓXIMOS MESES La última encuesta realizada por Opina Argentina reveló que el pesimismo sobre el futuro económico alcanzó en agosto su nivel más alto desde el final del gobierno Alberto Fernández. Según el Informe de Expectativas Económicas, el 60% de los consultados considera que su situación personal empeorará en los próximos meses. Este dato representa un salto de 7 puntos porcentuales respecto al mes anterior y consolida una tendencia que se agravó de forma sostenida durante el año. El informe, elaborado sobre una muestra de 1507 casos encuestados de forma online en todo el país entre el 7 y el 11 de agosto, revela que el malhumor social vinculado al rumbo de la economía dejó de ser una percepción coyuntural para convertirse en un “rasgo estructural de la opinión pública”. En esa línea, para los consultados la estabilización de los indicadores macroeconómicos no se tradujo en una mejora del bolsillo de las familias, y esa brecha entre los datos “macro” y la experiencia cotidiana es la que domina el estado de ánimo de la población. 🔗infob.ae/46mSCWU

A world with zero discrimination would still produce wildly unequal group outcomes. Thomas Sowell demonstrated how firstborn sons score higher on IQ tests and land more prestigious careers than their younger brothers, but nobody blames discrimination for that gap. Canadian junior hockey shows that players born January through March dominate the leagues because the January 1 cutoff makes them the oldest and strongest kids in every age group. Overseas Chinese communities run retail across Southeast Asia, Lebanese merchants dominate trade in West Africa, and German immigrants once owned the American brewing industry. Same specialization repeats under completely different majorities and legal systems. Treating every disparity as automatic proof of discrimination starts with the wrong diagnosis, and the wrong diagnosis never delivers the right cure. But the fantasy that some planner can just rearrange people like chess pieces and force equal results remains one of the most stubborn fallacies in economics. Video

QUÉ DICE LA CIENCIA SOBRE LAS REACCIONES QUE PROVOCA EL EJERCICIO | Por Fausto Urriste L’Équipe retrató a deportistas cuyo cuerpo reacciona al esfuerzo físico como si fuera una amenaza. Investigaciones especializadas respaldan el fenómeno y explican los mecanismos detrás de urticaria, broncoconstricción y anafilaxia inducidas por el ejercicio Salió a correr una mañana y terminó en el hospital. Las manos se le hincharon, los oídos le ardían y el aire dejó de entrar con normalidad. Sophie Sanjuan, corredora de trail running de 41 años, no había sufrido ningún accidente: su propio cuerpo reaccionó al ejercicio como si fuera una amenaza. El diagnóstico, obtenido tras dos episodios similares, fue una alergia a las proteínas de transferencia de lípidos (LTP), activada únicamente cuando corría. Según L’Équipe, detrás de la expresión coloquial “alergia al deporte” hay patologías documentadas que afectan a deportistas recreativos y de competición. Entre ellas, médicos franceses distinguen la urticaria inducida por el ejercicio y la anafilaxia inducida por el ejercicio, una reacción menos frecuente pero potencialmente mortal. 🔗infob.ae/4iqj757

Exclusive: Iran shut down a British power plant for four days in an unprecedented cyber attack, @Telegraph can reveal tonight. It is thought to be the first time that hackers affiliated to the Iranian regime have succeeded in closing down such a facility in the UK, and believed to be the most successful cyber attack of its kind. The incident took place at the same time as a series of attacks on US water infrastructure that affected 12 states last month. En ese marco, la Media Maratón de Buenos Aires dejó una postal histórica: Yomif Kejelcha Atomsa cruzó la meta en soledad, detuvo el reloj en 56 minutos y 50 segundos y estableció un nuevo récord mundial en la distancia de 21 kilómetros. La noticia sacudió el calendario del atletismo global y ubicó a la capital argentina entre las grandes plazas del fondo internacional. El ambiente fue de celebración, con la Banda de la Armada encargada de interpretar el Himno Nacional para dar comienzo a la competencia. La largada se llevó a cabo de manera escalonada a partir de las 8 de la mañana, desde Avenida Figueroa Alcorta y Dorrego, y marcó el inicio de la prueba más convocante del calendario local. La edición 2026 reunió a 31.500 inscriptos y consolidó a la Media Maratón porteña entre las cinco más populosas del mundo. La organización renovó el circuito: eliminó los tramos por autopista y trazó un recorrido que serpenteó por la 9 de Julio, Avenida del Libertador y otros puntos emblemáticos de la ciudad, como el obelisco y la Facultad de Derecho de la UBA, con llegada en los bosques de Palermo. 🔗infob.ae/4guBYtk

Prompting is becoming an underrated professional skill. Context. Objective. Facts. Constraints. Sources. Expected output. The clearer the thinking behind the instruction, the more useful the AI response becomes.

Most immigration consultants are already using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools. But using AI and knowing how to instruct AI properly are two very different things. A vague prompt usually produces a vague or generic response.

Annual spending on the renovation, furnishing and repair of the official residences of Union Ministers in Delhi's Lutyens bungalow zone rose to a record Rs 92.35 crore in 2025-26, more than three times the Rs 27.47 crore spent in 2014-15, according to information obtained by PTI through an RTI query. The government spent Rs 547.68 crore on these works between 2014-15 and 2025-26 through the Central Public Works Department, which handles repairs, renovation and maintenance. Officials said the 2025-26 figure was the highest since 2014, citing inflation and the growing cost of maintaining ageing structures spread across large compounds in central Delhi. CPWD officials have over the years pointed to problems such as seepage, termite infestation, ageing electrical systems and plumbing faults. There have also been plans in the past, though never officially announced, to raze and rebuild some of the bungalows. "These are mostly 80-90-100-year-old bungalows. Some, though not all, had even become structurally unsafe and needed to be upgraded," an official said. The bungalow zone was developed between 1912 and 1930 as part of the building of New Delhi as the imperial capital and was later adapted for senior government functionaries after Independence. Besides ministers, the bungalows are occupied by members of Parliament, senior judges and top military officers, among others. From 2014 to 2019, ministers spent an average of Rs 26.78 crore a year on repairs and upgradation. The average annual spending then rose to nearly Rs 50 crore from 2019 to 2024. The spend was Rs 71.98 crore in 2024-25 and Rs 92.35 crore in 2025-26. #UnionMinisters #LutyensDelhi #CPWD #GovernmentSpending #Delhi #RTI

A reunion 26 years in the making. U.S. teacher Ronald Sakolsky returned to Inner Mongolia, China, to reunite with tree planter Yin Yuzhen. In 1999, he raised 5,000 U.S. dollars to support her fight against desertification. Today, the saplings have grown into a forest of 50,000 trees, and a friendship rooted in the desert has grown just as strong. Video

In 1999, while working as an English teacher in China, Ronald Sakolsky was moved to tears by a TV report about Yin Yuzhen, a rural Chinese woman battling the encroaching sands of the Mu Us Desert in northern China by planting trees. Sakolsky spent two months raising $5,000 to support her efforts. The money helped Yin painstakingly plant and nurture a forest of roughly 50,000 trees. Now 69, Sakolsky has returned to China for his third visit. Yin was there to welcome him at the airport. Both were moved to tears as the longtime friends embraced. Video

On August 23, Ronald Sakolsky, an American friend who has long supported China's desertification control efforts, arrived in the country. At an emotional reunion with Yin Yuzhen — a celebrated female #desert warrior — a journalist from the National Geographic Society said to her in admiration: "You are a superhero! A soil hero!" The reporter's praise was directed at this remarkable woman, whose decades of work have turned barren land green. Video

On Sunday, Ronald Sakolsky touched down in #Ordos, where Yin Yuzhen and her family greeted him with flowers and a warm embrace. Back in 1999, while teaching in Luoyang, Sakolsky was moved by Yin's story of fighting desertification and raised $5,000 for the cause. She used the money to plant 50,000 trees which have since grown into a towering forest in the Maowusu sandy area. The two met briefly in 2000 but lost touch for over two decades — until this May, when Yin posted a video asking for help in finding him. Eventually, with some help from netizens, they reconnected online. #FriendshipAcrossOceans #DesertificationFight Video

VIDEO | Mumbai: After holding'Maidan Bachao Tiranga Andolan,' to protect the Neville D'Souza football turf in Bandra, Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Aaditya Thackeray said, "The fact is Bandra is known for its football just like Madanpura or many other places across Mumbai. Across Bandra what we are seeing is that there is one particular trust, one particular foundation which works under the name of a medical foundation, but has been trying to capture plots left, right, center. Most of the plots and open spaces in Bandra have been taken over by this one foundation which has a very strong political backing. The foundation is also using public funds and district planning funds which is a conflict of interest to install their own courts of paddle, pickle, cricket. The problem is not with installing sports facilities, the problem is privatising them, gatekeeping them and ensuring that money is taken out of Mumbaikar's pockets left, right and center." He added, "When Lionel Messi visited Mumbai, he was taken to a cricket stadium because neither the Mumbai nor the state football associations were properly involved. It was reduced to a photo op, a selfie pose for the Chief Minister alongside Messi. Beyond that, the announced 'Project Mahadeva' has stalled. The selected kids have been sent back to their regular schools instead of being enrolled in the project. Meanwhile, football grounds across Mumbai are being stripped away and turned into concrete structures, that is the truly sad part." (Full video available on PTI Videos - ptivideos.com) Video

La Cámara de Apelación en lo Civil y Comercial de Morón determinó que tanto el concesionario como la automotriz deben indemnizarlo, tras una pericia que confirmó la intervención oculta sobre la chapa y constató el daño. El reclamo se originó tras una reparación insatisfactoria realizada sobre un automóvil en un taller oficial de la marca, en octubre de 2017, en una localidad de la zona oeste del Gran Buenos Aires. El demandante, de 37 años en ese momento, llevó su vehículo a la concesionaria para cambiar la luneta trasera rota, siguiendo la recomendación de acudir a un establecimiento autorizado. Tras la intervención, el propietario detectó un defecto en la pintura y el alineamiento del portón trasero, situación que motivó el reclamo judicial. 🔗infob.ae/4xzxIjH

ہے‘ اس کا علاج خلیج فارس کے پانیوں میں ہو رہا ہے۔ امریکی تاریخ کا سب سے بڑبولا صدر جو من مانیاں کیے جا رہا تھا‘ پھنسا تو کیسے پھنسا۔ جسے چند ہفتوں کی جنگ سمجھا جا رہا تھا چھٹے ماہ میں پہنچ چکی ہے اورگو امریکی بے قراری انتہا پہ ہے کہ اس جنگ سے جان چھڑائی جائے‘ نکلنے کا راستہ نہیں مل رہا۔ دیگر باتوں کو چھوڑیے جو امریکہ کے ایئرکرافٹ کیریئرز کے ساتھ ہو رہا ہے وہ کہانی اپنا سبق رکھتی ہے۔ یہ دنیا کے طاقتور ترین بحری جہاز ہیں جو 70سے 80لڑاکا طیارے لیے پھرتے ہیں۔ نیوکلیئر پاور سے چلتے ہیں جس کا مطلب ہے کہ سمندروں میں لمبا عرصہ گزار سکتے ہیں۔ ایئرکرافٹ کیریئر ابراہم لنکن کوئی نو ماہ سے سمندروں میں ٹوتھ پیسٹ اور ٹوتھ برش ان کی کمی واقع ہو رہی ہے اور سب سے سنگین مسئلہ یہ کہ باتھ روموں کے آگے لائنیں لگی ہوتی ہیں اور کتنے ہی باتھ روم کام نہیں کر رہے۔ کسی باتھ روم کا پانی باہر نکل رہا ہو تو اندازہ کیا جا سکتا ہے کہ استعمال کرنے والوں پر کیا بیت رہی ہو گی۔ اس سے پہلے ایئرکرافٹ کیریئر جیرالڈ آر فورڈ کے لانڈری روم میں آگ بڑھک اٹھی تھی۔ امریکیوں نے آگ کو حادثاتی کہا لیکن خبریں تھیں کہ کوئی ایرانی پہنچا ہے۔ ہمارے برادر سعودیوں کو مشکلات کا سامنا ہے۔ آبنائے ہرمز سے ان کا کوئی تیل باہر نہیں نکل رہا اور حوثیوں کے حملوں کی وجہ سے بحیرۂ احمر کا راستہ بھی زیادہ تر بند پڑا ہے۔ ان سب برادر ملکوں کا رکھوالا اور گاڈ فادر امریکہ تھا اور امریکہ کا اپنا حشر ہو رہا ہے کہ اپنے عسکری اڈوں کی حفاظت نہیں کر سکا۔ اپنی مؤکل ریاستوں کی اس نے کیا حفاظت کرنی تھی۔ اس وقت مؤکل پریشان اور رکھوالے کے ہوش بھی اڑے کی بنیاد ڈالی گئی تو اس میں تین ممالک شامل تھے: مصر‘ شام اور یمن۔ یمن میں ایک قبائلی بغاوت ہوئی اور جمال عبدالناصر کے برے دن آنے تھے کہ 1962ء میں انہوں نے مصری فوجی دستے یمن بھیجے۔ وہاں جا کے مصری فوج ہے۔ یہ بھادوں کی گرمی اور بلوچستان کے پہاڑ۔ کوئی بھی ریگولر آرمی ‘ روس کی امریکہ کی یا کسی اور ملک کی‘ کسی گوریلا جنگ میں پھنسنا حماقت ہوتی ہے۔ سوویت یونین افغانستان میں آ کے پھنس گیا‘ اس کے بعد امریکی آئے سترہ برس تک اسلحہ پھونکتے رہے اور آخرکار انہیں ہار ماننا پڑی۔ جدید تاریخ میں شاذ و نادر ہی کوئی مثال ملتی ہے کہ ریگولر فوج کسی گوریلا جنگ میں کامیاب ہوئی ہو۔ ویتنام کی مثال ہمارے سامنے ہے‘ پانچ لاکھ امریکی فوجی وہاں دھونسے گئے تھے‘ اور دنیا کی طاقتور ترین فوج کو ویتنام کے جنگلوں اور چاول کے کھیتوں میں عبرتناک شکست کا سامنا کرنا پڑا۔ یہ تو وینزویلا جیسے کمزور ملک ہوتے ہیں جو تھوڑا سا صدر کو اس کے محل سے اٹھا کر امریکی فورسز لے گئیں۔ لیکن کیوبا پر ڈائریکٹ حملے کی ہمت امریکہ کو نہیں ہو گی کیونکہ پتا ہے کہ فیڈل کاسترو کا ملک مزاحمت کرے گا۔ معاشی مشکلات میں کیوبا ڈوبا ہوا ہے لیکن ہمت ضرورت ہے۔ اور جہاں گوریلا جنگوں کا تعلق ہے تو ہمیں ویتنام اور افغانستان کی جنگوں سے سبق حاصل کرنا چاہیے۔ ہماری ریگولر فوج ہے‘ شروع دن سے حریف ہندوستان کو سمجھا جاتا رہا ہے۔ ہماری ساری ٹریننگ‘ ہماری فورسز کی ساری ہیئت ہندوستان کو بطورِ دشمن سامنے رکھتے ہوئے تیار ہوئی ہے۔ گزرے وقتوں میں افغانستان سے بارڈر پر معمولی نوعیت کی مشکلات ہوا کرتی تھیں۔ یہ تو ہمارے سرخیلوں نے حالات کو نہ سمجھتے ہوئے 'मंथन4युवा'च्या माध्यमातून तरुणाईला नव कल्पनांचे व्यासपीठ! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी आज नागपूर येथे 'मंथन4युवा' समारोप कार्यक्रम येथे प्रमुख उपस्थिती दर्शवली. शिक्षण कौशल्य, क्रीडा स्टार्टअप आदी क्षेत्रात युवा पिढीचा सकारात्मक सहभाग वाढविण्यासोबतच संपूर्ण मदत देण्यात येईल त्यासोबत स्टार्टअप इकोसिस्टीम मध्ये चर्चा करून चांगली पॉलिसी तयार करण्यात येईल, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी केले. नागपूर येथील रेशीमबाग मैदानावर 'मंथन4युवा' या उपक्रमांतर्गत ढोल ताशा पथकाचा जागतिक विक्रम तसेच विविध क्षेत्रातील आयकॉन असलेल्या व्यक्तींसोबत थेट संवाद, नशामुक्त महाराष्ट्र व देश यासाठी युवकांना शपथ आदी उपक्रमाचे आयोजन करण्यात आले होते. यावेळी 25,000 पेक्षा जास्त युवक व युवती सहभागी झाले होते. महाराष्ट्राची परंपरा असलेल्या विविध ढोल ताशा पथकांतील 4100 ढोल-ताशा वादकांनी एकत्रितपणे भव्य वादन सादर करत एशिया बुक ऑफ रेकॉर्ड्स, इंडिया बुक ऑफ रेकॉर्ड्स आणि वर्ल्ड रेकॉर्ड्स बुक ऑफ इंडियामध्ये विक्रम नोंदविला आहे. तसेच आधार नोंद असलेल्या 585 ध्वजधारकांच्या या उपक्रमामुळे जागतिक विक्रमाची नोंद झाली आहे. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी विश्वविक्रम केल्याबद्दल या संपूर्ण चमुचे अभिनंदन केले. 25,000 पेक्षा जास्त युवकांच्या साक्षीने हा उपक्रम पूर्ण झाला असल्याचे सांगताना मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, आजची युवा पिढी सर्वच क्षेत्रात आपल्या कौशल्याने नावलौकिक मिळवीत आहे. सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रमांमध्ये सर्वाधिक सहभाग लाभलेल्या ध्वजधारकांच्या समावेशाबद्दल विश्वविक्रमामध्ये नोंद झाली असून यापूर्वी 260 ध्वज धारकांचा समावेश असलेला विक्रम आज मोडीत निघाला आहे. सुप्रसिद्ध क्रीडा समालोचक रिद्धिमा पाठक यांनी युवकांचे आयकॉन असलेले मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांच्यासोबतच भारतीय क्रिकेटपटू तिलक वर्मा, 'कॉमनवेल्थ गेम्स 2026' मधील सुवर्णपदक विजेते पॅरा-ॲथलिट दिलीप गावित, जेनेरिक आधारचे संस्थापक व मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी अर्जुन देशपांडे, गो झीरोचे संस्थापक व मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी किरण शाह यांच्या सोबत संवाद साधताना विविध क्षेत्रातील त्यांच्या कार्याची प्रेरणा व अनुभव युवकांसमोर शेअर केला. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, संविधानामुळेच लोकशाही प्रगल्भ झाली आहे. आपल्या लोकशाहीमुळेच मला नगरसेवक, महापौर, आमदार आणि मुख्यमंत्री या पदापर्यंत पोहोचणे शक्य झाले असल्याचे त्यांनी सांगितले. स्टार्टअप संदर्भात बोलताना मुख्यमंत्री म्हणाले, युवकांना शासनाची संपूर्ण मदत करण्याचे धोरण असून स्टार्टअपसाठी इकोसिस्टीम पॉलिसी तयार करण्यात आली आहे. या धोरणामध्ये युवकांना 100 % मदत करण्याचा उद्देश्य असल्याने युवकांसोबत चर्चा करून आणखी चांगली पॉलिसी तयार करण्यात येईल, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी केले. मुख्यमंत्री म्हणाले, मुलांचा स्क्रीन टाईम कमी करण्यासाठी विचारमंथन सुरू आहे. स्क्रीनवरून मैदानावर कसे वळवता येईल याबद्दलही या क्षेत्रातील तज्ज्ञांकडून निश्चित धोरण ठरविण्यात येणार आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. 'मंथन4युवा' या उपक्रमांतर्गत 1 ऑगस्ट ते 23 ऑगस्ट पर्यंत विविध उपक्रम राबविण्यात आले असून या उपक्रमातील यशस्वी स्पर्धकांना मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते पुरस्कार देऊन गौरव करण्यात आले. तसेच विविध क्षेत्रातील आयकॉन म्हणून ओळख असलेल्या युवक व युवतींचा गौरव करून त्यांच्या विविध क्षेत्रातील कार्याची माहिती देण्यात आली. VIDEO | Bhubaneswar: Still carrying the disappointment of his Commonwealth Games failure, Indian javelin thrower Rohit Yadav said he is determined to use his improved form as a springboard for a big performance at the Asian Games. Ever since Neeraj Chopra's historic Olympic gold at the Tokyo 2020 Games, India have continued to strengthen their presence in men's javelin, with several throwers emerging through the ranks. Yadav took another significant step forward at the World Athletics Continental Tour Silver meet in Bhubaneswar on Saturday, producing a career-best 87.68m to win the event. "At the Commonwealth Games, after my second throw, I felt I would definitely make the top eight. I tried to go all out with the third throw, but it went out of the sector. There was also wind and cold weather there, and because of the conditions and the way the javelin reacted, I could not produce the kind of throw I had expected," Rohit said. "I still feel very disappointed because I believe if I had produced the throw I made here, the result would have been much better. I have been carrying that disappointment since then. The throw I produced here has made me feel a little better, and in the coming competitions I want to do even better," he added. (Full video available on PTI Videos - ptivideos.com) Video

برنامه جهانی غذا در افغانستان از کمک سه میلیون دالری کوریای جنوبی خبر داده است. این نهاد امروز (یک‌شنبه، 1 سنبله) در ایکس نوشته است که این کمک در ۱۲ ماه آینده برای فراهم‌کردن کمک‌های غذایی و تغذیه‌ای به ۲۴ هزار و ۵۰۰ زن و کودک آسیب‌پذیر در سراسر افغانستان استفاده خواهد شد. جان آیلیف، مدیر برنامه جهانی غذا در افغانستان به‌تازگی درباره‌ی کاهش بودجه‌ی این نهاد هشدار داده و گفته است که کودکان در افغانستان همین حالا در نتیجه‌ی کاهش کمک‌ها جان خود را از دست می‌دهند. آیلیف گفته است که بودجه‌ی برنامه جهانی غذا به‌شدت کاهش یافته است و تنها ۱۲ درصد تأمین مالی شده است. براساس آمار برنامه جهانی غذا، نزدیک به ۱۴ میلیون نفر در افغانستان دچار سوءتغذیه هستند. این سازمان پیش‌بینی کرده است که در سال جاری ۳.۷ میلیون کودک و ۱.۲ میلیون زن باردار و شیرده با سوءتغذیه حاد مواجه شوند.

مسئولان محلی طالبان در ولایت هلمند می‌گویند که از میان شماری از افراد گم‌شده در ریگزارهای این ولایت، یک مرد، یک زن و دو کودک پیدا شده‌اند. به گفته مقام‌های محلی طالبان، گروهی از این افراد به شمول زنان و کودکان، از روز دیروز (شنبه، 1 سنبله) در ریگزارهای بهرامچه ناپدید شده‌اند. طالبان هنوز نگفته‌اند که چه تعداد نفر در این ریگزارها گم شده‌اند. راشد هلمندی، رییس اطلاعات و فرهنگ طالبان در هلمند در ایکس نوشته است که شمار بیشتری از افراد گم‌شده در ریگزار پیدا شده‌اند. او گفته است: «افراد گم‌شده در ریگزار، شامل یک مرد، دو کودک و یک زن بودند که پیدا شدند. همه آنان سالم هستند. تنها راننده‌ای که پیش از دیگران از این افراد جدا شده بود، هنوز ناپدید است و جست‌وجو برای یافتن او ادامه دارد.‌» هلمندی درباره‌ی این که این افراد چگونه در ریگزارهای ناپدید شده، توضیح نداده است. ریگزارهای هلمند دارای دشت‌های وسیعی است و گاه‌وبیگاه شماری از شهروندان مسیر خود را در این مناطق گم کرده و ناپدید می‌شوند. Сьогодні на Національному молитовному сніданку в одному залі поруч один з одним знаходяться люди різних церков, політичних поглядів, різних професій і національностей. Але саме такі заходи підкреслюють: будь-які розбіжності між нами не мають значення, коли мова йде про головне – правду, мир і про те, як молитва у важкі миті єднає всіх. Це та спільна мова, якою ми не завжди говоримо одне з одним, але якою вміємо говорити з небом про найважливіше. Говоріть про Україну більше, робіть для України більше, відвідуйте українців, коли це можливо. Адже всі ми сьогодні прагнемо не лише миру на нашій землі – ми боремось за безпеку і майбутнє України, Європи, усього світу, де мають панувати не війна і страх, а найкраще в людях: повага, добро, право кожного на життя. Помолімося сьогодні за три важливі речі. За тих, хто в полоні, – щоб дочекалися. За тих, хто в бою, – щоб повернулися. І за мир для України – справедливий і довгий. Video

Today, at the National Prayer Breakfast, in one hall, side by side, are people of different faiths, political views, professions, and nationalities. But events like this underscore that any differences between us do not matter when it comes to what matters most. Truth. Peace. And how prayer, in difficult moments, unites everyone. This is the common language we do not always speak with one another. But it is the language we know how to use when we speak to heaven about what matters most. Speak more about Ukraine, do more for Ukraine, visit Ukrainians whenever possible. Because today, all of us seek not only peace on our land; we are fighting for the security and future of Ukraine, Europe, and the entire world, where not war and fear should prevail, but the best in people: respect, kindness, and every person's right to life. Let us pray today for three important things. For those in captivity – that they may make it through. For those in battle – that they may return. And for peace for Ukraine – just and lasting.

Відвідали інтерактивну виставку «Той день», присвячену 35-річчю відновлення незалежності України. «Той день» – це про українців та українок. Про нашу історію, сьогодення і майбутнє держави. Про великий день – 24 серпня 1991 року, про шлях, який ми вже пройшли, про нашу боротьбу, силу, пам'ять, про невід’ємні риси українського характеру і про те, яким ми уявляємо власне завтра та ще один, не менш важливий «той день» – коли Україна здобуде свій достойний мир. На відвідувачів виставки чекають інтерактивні зони, присвячені подіям відновлення незалежності України, роботи видатних українських художників та митців, VR-технології, завдяки яким можна побувати в кабінеті Президента України, опинитися в залі засідань Верховної Ради України, побачити зоряне небо таким, яким воно було 24 серпня 1991 року. Вперше на широкий загал будуть представлені символи Глави Української держави: булава, печатка, нагрудний знак і президентський штандарт – та міжнародні відзнаки, отримані за час повномасштабної війни. Слава Україні!

गुड्डू पंडित ने बता दिया 'मिर्जापुर: द मूवी' का सीक्रेट, कहानी समझने के लिए देखना होगा सीजन 1 'मिर्जापुर' वेब सीरीज देखने के बाद अब दर्शकों को फिल्म 'मिर्जापुर: द मूवी' का बेसब्री से इंतजार है. ‘मिर्जापुर’ वेब सीरीज के बाद अब इसकी कहानी बड़े पर्दे पर आगे बढ़ने वाली है. फैंस एक बार फिर गुड्डू पंडित, कालीन भैया और मुन्ना भैया जैसे किरदारों को नए अंदाज में देखने के लिए उत्साहित हैं. 'मिर्जापुर: द मूवी' भारतीय सिनेमा की सबसे बहुप्रतीक्षित फिल्मों में से एक बनकर उभरी है और इसकी घोषणा के बाद से ही फैंस के बीच उत्सुकता लगातार बढ़ रही है. भारत की सबसे बड़ी ओटीटी फ्रेंचाइजी का यह थिएट्रिकल सफर पहली बार मिर्जापुर की इस रोमांचक दुनिया को बड़े पर्दे पर लेकर आ रहा है. हाल ही में रिलीज हुए इसके धमाकेदार टीजर और ट्रेलर ने दर्शकों के बीच इस फिल्म को लेकर रोमांच को और अधिक बढ़ा दिया है. इसी बीच सीरीज के गुड्डू पंडित उर्फ अली फजल ने बताया है कि फिल्म की कहानी सीरीज के बाद कहां से शुरू होती है और दर्शकों को इस बार क्या नया देखने को मिलेगा. एक्टर ने अपने फैंस से एक खास अपील की है. . . फिल्म के रिलीज होने की उत्सुकता के बीच, गुड्डू पंडित का मुख्य किरदार निभाने वाले एक्टर अली फजल ने दर्शकों से एक खास अपील की है. पटना में प्रमोशनल विजिट के दौरान अली फजल ने फिल्म और सीरीज के बीच के कनेक्शन को समझाते हुए बताया कि दर्शकों को फिल्म की शुरुआत समझने के लिए मिर्जापुर सीजन 1 को केवल एपिसोड 6 तक ही देखना चाहिए. उन्होंने साफ-साफ कहा कि 'सभी को घर जाकर सीरीज 1 देखनी चाहिए, लेकिन सिर्फ एपिसोड 6 तक. क्योंकि एपिसोड 6 से ही फिल्म की कहानी शुरू होती है और घूमती है.' उनके इस बयान ने दर्शकों में सीरीज को दोबारा देखने और फिर फिल्म से कहानी को जोड़ने की उत्सुकता को दोगुना कर दिया है. #Mirzapur #MirzapurTheMovie #AliFazal
