ऑपरेशन सिंदूर में तबाह जैश का अड्डा फिर हुआ आबाद! बहावलपुर कैंप में लौटे आतंकी, सरकार ने दिए 25 करोड़ भारतीय सेना के ऑपरेशन सिंदूर में बहावलपुर में स्थित आतंकी संगठन जैश-ए-मोहम्मद से जुड़े कई ठिकानों को नुकसान पहुंचने की बात सामने आई थी. बहावलपुर स्थित कैंप भी उन ठिकानों में शामिल बताया गया था. अब ताजा तस्वीरों में दावा किया जा रहा है कि जिस परिसर को नुकसान पहुंचा था, वहां दोबारा निर्माण और मरम्मत का काम किया गया है. सूत्रों के अनुसार, हमले में क्षतिग्रस्त हुए गुंबदों की मरम्मत कर दी गई है. कैंप के केंद्रीय भवन में नए प्लास्टर, रंगाई-पुताई और मार्बल लगाने का काम भी किया गया है. एजेंसियां इन गतिविधियों को लेकर सतर्क हैं और पूरे घटनाक्रम पर नजर बनाए हुए हैं. रिपोर्ट्स में यह भी कहा गया है कि जैश-ए-मोहम्मद ने अपने ढांचों के पुनर्निर्माण के लिए कथित तौर पर आर्थिक सहायता जुटाने की अपील की थी. . . कुछ सूत्रों का दावा है कि पाकिस्तान की शीर्ष नेतृत्व से भी इस काम के लिए वित्तीय मदद उपलब्ध कराई गई. सूत्रों के मुताबिक, पुनर्निर्माण के लिए करोड़ों रुपये की राशि किस्तों में दी गई, जिसमें एक बड़ा हिस्सा केंद्रीय हॉल के निर्माण और मरम्मत पर खर्च होने की बात कही जा रही है. हालांकि इन दावों की स्वतंत्र पुष्टि नहीं हो सकी है.खुफिया एजेंसियां सामने आई तस्वीरों और वीडियो की जांच कर रही हैं. सुरक्षा विशेषज्ञों का मानना है कि यदि इन दावों की पुष्टि होती है, तो यह संकेत होगा कि पहले क्षतिग्रस्त किए गए ढांचों को दोबारा खड़ा करने की कोशिश की जा रही है. फिलहाल इस मामले पर आधिकारिक स्तर पर कोई विस्तृत बयान जारी नहीं किया गया है. #OperationSindoor #Bahawalpur #Camp #Pakistan #PakistanNews

But these treasures face a constant battle against time, sand and decay. For decades, conservators at the Dunhuang Academy have worked to protect them through mural restoration, desert control and digital preservation. By combining traditional craftsmanship with modern technology, they are helping this thousand-year-old legacy endure for generations to come. Video

Its secret protocols divided Eastern Europe into spheres of influence, paving the way for the invasion and partition of Poland, the occupation of the Baltic States and the subjugation of much of Eastern Europe. The names of the dictators have changed, but the ambition has not. Adolf Hitler and Joseph Stalin sought to redraw Europe by force. Today, Vladimir Putin carries that same imperialist torch, attempting to impose his will on sovereign neighbours and overturn the European security order. History should leave us in no doubt: when dictators are allowed to carve up nations, peace is not preserved — it is surrendered. eutoday.net #EUToday

Read this slowly. ​Before her passing from stomach cancer, the iconic designer Cressida Rodriguez left behind a chilling reminder of what actually matters when the curtain falls: ​"I had the most expensive cars parked in my garage, but now I move in a wheelchair." ​"My closets were filled with couture and luxury, but my body is now wrapped in a standard hospital gown." ​"I had millions in the bank, but not a single dollar could purchase a second of extra time." ​"My home was built like a palace, yet I finish my life in a narrow hospital bed." ​"I used to sign autographs for crowds, but today I only sign medical consent forms." ​"I used seven personal stylists for my hair, and now I have none left to comb." ​"I flew across the world on private jets, but now it takes two people just to help me reach the doorway." ​"I could feast on anything on earth, yet my dinner has shrunk to two pills and a few drops of saline." ​"None of the fame, the money, the cars, or the glory can comfort you in the end. There is nothing more real than life, and nothing more certain than death." ​You are richer than you think if you woke up today with breath in your lungs, strength in your legs, and a quiet plate of food in front of you. ​Do not wait for a diagnosis to start appreciating the ordinary. Hold your health close, cherish the people around you, and be deeply grateful for the simple gift of today.

This reminds me of a CritSit I was sent on back in my Microsoft PFE days... Customer had a 16-node Exchange 2010 cluster fail because heartbeat traffic wasn't flowing. When I got there, onsite support from VMWare, Cisco, and NetApp were already there trying to prove they weren't the cause of the outage. Nobody can figure it out. I have the customer logon to one of the Exchange Servers, and first thing I notice is a McAfee icon in the system tray, so I ask if they're running HIPS. They are, so I ask if they've tried temporarily disabling it. They had, to no effect. Something tells me HIPS is still to blame. I dig through logs, find a McAfee update was installed right before the cluster went down. Ask customer to humor me and completely disable McAfee suite on a server. They reluctantly agree. Disabled, verified all McAfee services are stopped. Heartbeat still not flowing. Bust out procmon and netmon, prove McAfee filter driver is still messing with network traffic even though everything is "disabled". Tell everyone that the heartbeat network traffic is never leaving the OS because McAfee filter driver is blocking it. VMware and Cisco support look at their data then look at mine and say "He's right." Tell customer to get McAfee support, the only vendor NOT in the room, on the phone. Tier 1 support of course follows their script and starts asking customer to do basic stuff they've already done. I interrupt, introduce myself, tell them who else is in the room, inform them that our mutual customer is burning thousands of dollars an hour in support costs alone, ask them to escalate to their top tier support ASAP. Get top tier McAfee support on the line. Ask them why their filter driver is blocking things when everything is disabled. "I don't know... it shouldn't..." No, it shouldn't. Show him my evidence. He gets one of their developers on the line. Developer is baffled too. They admit their driver is causing the problem but have no idea how to fix it. I thank them and tell them that I must recommend complete uninstall of their software to restore operation, and that it must remain uninstalled until they've proven a fix. Customer uninstalls McAfee from the entire Exchange cluster. Heartbeat traffic now flowing, everything returns to a healthy operational state.

Former Prime Minister Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto wanted to make Sohni Dharti the second national anthem of Paksitan. The footage was captured in 1973 in Lahore during a public event. Bhutto stands with the famous music director Sohail Rana and a group of young children. He enthusiastically claps, smiles, and sings along to the melody. Video Rubab (@rubabbx) The song that asked God to protect the land rather than demanding victory over someone else. Sohni Dharti Allah Rakhe. Beautiful land, may Allah keep it. Step by step, may it remain prosperous. Masroor Anwar wrote the words. Sohail Rana set them to music. Shahnaz Begum, then based in what was still East Pakistan, gave them their first and most lasting voice. The year was 1970. The lyrics treat the country as something intimate. Every grain of soil more precious than life. A wish that future generations will still sing of its greatness. No enemy is named. No battle is celebrated. Only the land and the hope that it will endure. After the events of 1971 the song took on a new weight. What had been a patriotic piece for a united country became a quiet affirmation of the Pakistan that remained. Zulfikar Ali Bhutto described it as the second national anthem and was known to sing along when it was performed. It settled into the life of the country. School assemblies. National days. Official functions. Radio and television. Later covers kept it in circulation, but the original recording never lost its place. Masroor Anwar was a poet of ghazals and film songs who also wrote for the screen. He gave the nation one of its most enduring expressions of belonging. He died in 1996. The song did not. Sohni Dharti remains what it was at the beginning: a prayer for the soil underfoot and the people who live on it. NIA का कहना है कि सईद पाकिस्तान में है और उसे भारत लाकर अदालत के सामने पेश करना फिलहाल संभव नहीं है, लेकिन अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर हाफिज सईद को बेनकाब करने के लिए उसके खिलाफ उसकी गैरमौजूदगी में ट्रायल चलाया जाएगा. भारत में लागू नए आपराधिक कानून भारतीय नागरिक सुरक्षा संहिता यानी BNSS की धारा 356 के तहत कुछ परिस्थितियों में ऐसे आरोपी के खिलाफ उसकी गैरमौजूदगी में मुकदमा चलाया जा सकता है, जो जानबूझकर कानून से बच रहा हो और जिसे अदालत भगोड़ा घोषित कर चुकी हो. हालांकि इसके लिए कई कानूनी प्रक्रियाएं पूरी करनी होती हैं. पहले आरोपी को अदालत में पेश होने के लिए समन और वारंट जारी किए जाते हैं. इसके बाद भी अगर वह सामने नहीं आता तो उसे भगोड़ा घोषित किया जाता है, जिसकी एक प्रक्रिया होती है, लेकिन जब तमाम प्रक्रियाएं पूरी हो जाती हैं तो इसके बाद तय कानूनी शर्तें पूरी होने पर उसके खिलाफ उसकी गैरमौजूदगी में ट्रायल आगे बढ़ सकता है. #NIA #HafizSaeed #PahalamAttack

पहले आंखों में झोंका मिर्च पाउडर, फिर ईंट-डंडों से किया हमला... दिल्ली में पुलिस से मारपीट Delhi News: दिल्ली के भलस्वा डेयरी इलाके में ड्यूटी पर तैनात पुलिसकर्मियों पर हमला करने का मामला सामने आया है. घटना शनिवार, 22 अगस्त की दोपहर करीब 3 से 3:30 बजे के बीच मुकुंदपुर इलाके के जनता विहार की बताई जा रही है. पुलिस टीम इलाके में गश्त और गाड़ियों की जांच कर रही थी. इसी दौरान बिना कागजात की एक बाइक को जब्त किया गया. जानकारी के अनुसार, बाइक जब्त होने से नाराज बाइक मालिक अपने परिवार और कुछ साथियों के साथ मौके पर पहुंच गया. देखते ही देखते वहां लोगों की भीड़ जमा हो गई. आरोप है कि भीड़ ने पुलिसकर्मियों के साथ बदसलूकी शुरू कर दी और बाद में उन पर हमला कर दिया. . . आरोप है कि हमलावरों ने पुलिस वालों की आंखों में मिर्च पाउडर डाल दिया. इसके बाद लाठी-डंडों और ईंटों से पुलिस वालों पर हमला कर दिया. पुलिस टीम की मदद के लिए पहुंचे हेड कांस्टेबल टीनू के साथ भी मारपीट की गई. इस हमले में हेड कांस्टेबल दिनेश, राजेश और टीनू घायल हो गए. घटना के बाद इलाके में अफरा-तफरी का माहौल बन गया. पुलिस ने मामले की जांच शुरू कर दी है. पुलिस के अनुसार, इलाके के कुख्यात आरोपी सुनील उर्फ पंकज पर मुख्य हमलावर होने का आरोप है. बताया जा रहा है कि उसके खिलाफ पहले से गंभीर अपराधों सहित पांच मामले दर्ज हैं. पुलिस ने कार्रवाई करते हुए मौके से एक नाबालिग आरोपी को पकड़ लिया है. वहीं, मामले में शामिल दूसरे आरोपियों की पहचान और तलाश के लिए पुलिस की टीमें जुटी हुई हैं. इस घटना का एक वीडियो भी सामने आया है. वीडियो में कुछ लोग हाथों में लाठी-डंडे लेकर पुलिसकर्मियों पर हमला करते हुए दिखाई दे रहे हैं. पुलिस अब वीडियो और अन्य सबूतों के आधार पर आरोपियों की पहचान करने में जुटी है. मामले में आगे की कार्रवाई जारी है. #Delhi #DelhiPolice

З юності хлопець мріяв про військову службу, рівнявся на свого дядька-прикордонника і хотів присвятити життя захисту країни. З 2020 року служив за контрактом у Нацгвардії України. Влітку 2024 року, після інтенсивних навчань, чоловік поїхав на Покровський напрямок. У березні 2025-го перевівся до 4-го окремого загону спецпризначення «Омега», де продовжив службу у складі бойової групи. 2 грудня 2025 року Андрій відзначив свій 25-й день народження. На позиції поблизу Родинського розпочався штурм росіян. Підрозділ потрапив під сильний обстріл, зав’язався ближній бій. Андрій до останнього прикривав побратимів. Під час бою він отримав важке кульове поранення, але не залишив командування. Через щільний вогонь його не змогли евакуювати. Усю ніч він підтримував своїх бійців. Але вранці 3 грудня 2025 року Андрій Нашора помер від отриманого поранення. वाघा-अटारी बॉर्डर बंद, लेकिन 'सिंदूर' की जीत, कैसे सरहद पार कर भारत पहुंचीं 150 पाकिस्तानी दुल्हनें? अप्रैल 2025 में जम्मू-कश्मीर के पहलगाम में हुए आतंकी हमले के बाद भारत ने कई एक्शन लिए. पहलगाम आतंकी हमले के बाद भारतीय सेना ने ऑपरेशन सिंदूर को अंजाम दिया, जिसमें पाकिस्तान में स्थित 9 आतंकी ठिकानों को खंडहर में तब्दील कर दिया गया. वहीं, भारत सरकार की ओर से पाकिस्तान से जुड़ने वाला बॉर्डर बंद कर दिया, बॉर्डर बंद होने के कारण दोनों देशों के रिश्ते अपने निचले स्तर पर पहुंच गए हैं. दोनों देशों के बीच बढ़ते तनाव के कारण एक-दूसरे मुल्क के लोगों में शादी की उम्मीदें कम हो गईं. हालांकि, अब करीब डेढ़ साल बाद फिर से उम्मीदें जगी हैं. एक रिपोर्ट बताती है कि करीब 150 पाकिस्तानी दुल्हनें मस्कट, कोलंबो, ढाका, कतर और दुबई से कनेक्टिंग विमान लेकर भारत के अलग-अलग शहरों में पहुंची और शादी की रश्में निभाईं. बता दें कि गृह मंत्रालय की ओर से एक सम्मानित धार्मिक स्थल के साथ मिलकर इन यात्रों को खास छूट दी गई थी. . . इस आदेश के अनुसार, पाकिस्तानी रिश्तेदारों दुल्हन के साथ आने की इजाजत थी, लेकिन कंडिशन ये रखी गई वे सभी एक तय सीमा के भीतर वापस लौटेंगे. यही कारण है कि कुछ शादियां काफी सादगी से हुईं. पाकिस्तानी दुल्हनों को वीजा परमिट और दस्तावेज मिलने से उनमें खुशी की लहर थी. चूंकि, सामान्य स्थिति में भारत का वीजा रखने वाले पाकिस्तानी वाघा बॉर्डर से आसानी से आ-जा सकते थे, लेकिन अब बॉर्डर के बंद होने के कारण उन्होंने हवाई रास्ते से घूम कर आना पड़ता है. पाकिस्तान ने भारत के विमानों के लिए अपना एयरस्पेस अभी भी बंद कर रखा है. टीओआई की एक रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, इसी साल जून से अप्रैल के बीच में करीब 150 दुल्हनें अपने 450 रिश्तेदारों के साथ भारत आईं. रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, जो दुल्हनें शादी के लिए भारत पहुंची हैं, उनमें से अधिकांश की सगाई ऑपरेशन सिंदूर से पहले हो गई थी. कई जोड़ों ने पिछले साल ही शादी की योजना बनाई थी, लेकिन स्थितियां बदलने और बॉर्डर के बंद होने के बाद शादी में देरी हुई. लंबे समय से वीजा पर भारत में रहने वाले इंकेश जशनानी की सगाई 'ऑपरेशन सिंदूर' से पहले हुई थी. उन्होंने इसके बाद शादी की योजना बनाई. उनकी मंगेतर सिंध के खानपुर तहसील से भारत आ रही थीं, लेकिन वाघा बॉर्डर के बंद होने के कारण वह नहीं आ सकीं. इसके करीब एक साल बाद आरती ने हवाई मार्ग वाला विकल्प चुना. उन्होंने मस्कट होते हुए नागपुर पहुंचने का फैसला किया. वीजा पाबंदियों के कारण उनके साथ केवल उनके भाई आ सके. आरती का कहना है कि कास J’ai été voir le site de Cyberleek, le hacker de GTA 6, et ce n’est clairement pas un amateur. Je suis convaincu que ce n’est pas une seule personne, mais bien un groupe de hackers. Son système de contact fonctionne en deux étapes : - Il génère d’abord un compte Session (messagerie sécurisée, anonyme et décentralisée) avec une phrase de récupération unique. Ça permet à la personne qui veut le contacter d’avoir un canal de communication jetable et chiffré de bout en bout. - Ensuite, il génère un montant de donation en Monero (XMR), une cryptomonnaie anonyme. Contrairement à Bitcoin, Ethereum ou Solana, sa blockchain est privée et les montants des transactions sont complètement obfuscés. Personne ne peut donc voir combien tu as envoyé, sauf celui qui possède la clé privée (Cyberleek). Il demande 400 XMR (165 k$), mais ce qui est vraiment intéressant, ce sont les chiffres APRÈS la virgule. Il y a 12 décimales qui sont générées en même temps que le compte Session et servent d’identifiant unique. Quand tu envoies exactement ce montant, Cyberleek détecte la transaction sur la blockchain, extrait les décimales, recalcule l’ID Session correspondant et te contacte. D’après le site, c’est purement mathématique/cryptographique côté client. La page génère un ID de 12 chiffres lié mathématiquement au compte Session. Comme Monero cache les montants, seul Cyberleek peut déchiffrer le montant reçu et retrouver ton Session ID. Aucun stockage serveur de l’ID n’est nécessaire avant le paiement. Il précise d’ailleurs qu’il faut absolument envoyer les fonds depuis un wallet personnel (Cake Wallet, Feather...) et non depuis un exchange, sinon les décimales risquent d’être arrondies et il ne pourra jamais te retrouver. Je trouve que c’est un système plutôt élégant, et on retrouve d’ailleurs le même niveau de sophistication au niveau de l’infrastructure. Leur site ne peut quasiment pas être mis hors ligne durablement, car il est hébergé de façon décentralisée sur Arweave (stockage permanent et immuable sur blockchain) et que son contenu est accessible via de nombreux gateways du réseau ar(dot)io. Ces gateways sont des portes d’accès qui servent le même fichier HTML stocké sur Arweave. Faire tomber un gateway (ou même plusieurs) ne change presque rien puisque le site restera accessible sur tous les autres, et que de nouveaux miroirs pourront apparaître en quelques minutes. Tous ces éléments font que je suis convaincu que Cyberleek est un groupe et non une seule personne, et vu le mode opératoire, que ce sont des pros. Leurs connaissances en cryptographie et en utilisation de technologies décentralisées laissent penser qu’on est loin de simples script kiddies ou de hackers qui piratent uniquement via social engineering. Il y a là-dessous une vraie maîtrise technique. Le côté un peu enfantin / trolling laisse penser le contraire, mais le côté technique ne fait aucun doute. Même chose dans la manière dont ils gèrent leur communication : tout passe par leur site internet. Ils évitent volontairement tout réseau social qui pourrait laisser des logs et compromettre leur identité.

Dr. Jaishankar is absolutely right in observing that the Pakistan-Turkey-Saudi defense agreement (the Mecca Agreement) is unlikely, in the near term, to function like NATO’s Article 5. Yet he may have overlooked a more consequential reality: the agreement concerns long-cycle "climate change" in West Asia rather than short-term "weather fluctuations". What, then, constitutes this “climate change”? 1) The Abraham Accords that the Trump administration once brokered are becoming increasingly untenable. The more firmly the Mecca Agreement takes root, the more isolated Israel becomes. This dynamic essentially reflects a growing credibility deficit in Washington’s security commitments to its regional partners, thereby elevating the influence of alternative security providers such as Pakistan to an unprecedented degree. 2) The U.S.-promoted West Asian version of a Quad-like framework—the I2U2 grouping of India, Israel, the United Arab Emirates, and the United States—has effectively ceased to function. The Mecca Agreement places I2U2 in an extremely awkward position, risking it to be the region’s most notorious “axis of evil,” simultaneously resented by basically everyone, be it Shia or Sunni forces. 3) The once-promising India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) has effectively collapsed. With Iran exercising effective control over the Strait of Hormuz, the US turning increasingly isolationist, and the influence of Turkey and Pakistan steadily expanding, it is simply unrealistic to expect Europe and India to deploy expeditionary forces to provide the geopolitical security prerequisites for IMEC. Interestingly, both the Iranian foreign minister and Trump himself have expressed a welcome for the Mecca Agreement. The question, then, is who should be concerned about it? The Mecca Agreement may well represent the most significant geopolitical realignment in the region since the end of the Cold War—and one that is unlikely to work in India’s favor. There are live military situations that each of the three countries is facing. What has this pact done in response to that? Señor Melquisedec, Yo sé que usted puede verme como una recién graduada, quizás por mi apariencia, pero hace mucho que vengo ejerciendo la profesión, y sin estar precedida de escándalos. Así que no recurra a la difusión de groseros embustes. Para su información, me gradué en 2003 y, de hecho, fui funcionaria pública -en la Fiscalía- desde que estaba en pregrado. Hoy cuento con más de veinte años de experiencia profesional y, por supuesto, con buen crédito. No tengo antecedentes de ningún tipo, ni reputación de ser defensora de narcotraficantes, de negociar con recursos públicos, de abusar de posiciones de poder o de incurrir en conductas por el estilo. En cuanto a la experiencia para el cargo, que parece ser el punto de su cuestionamiento, conviene precisar que mi experiencia profesional ya fue acreditada por el Senado de la República cuando fui candidata a la Corte Constitucional y que, desde entonces, he sumado dos años y medio más de trayectoria. Incluso el Consejo de Estado, en un ácido examen sobre mi trayectoria profesional tuvo por acreditada mi experiencia general, es decir, aquella que es exigida para ser Magistrada del CNE. Lo que sostuvo en aquella decisión fue que mis estudios en Derecho Constitucional y mi maestría en Estudios Políticos no tenían “relación” con el cargo de Superintendente, que es algo distinto. Ese fallo, además, tuvo un contundente salvamento de voto del Presidente de la Sala - un conocido experto y eminencia en derecho electoral- y actualmente se encuentra en estudio una tutela sobre el caso. Lo que se discutió en aquella ocasión fue mi experiencia relacionada con el cargo de Superintendente, no mi experiencia profesional general, que es lo que se estudia para ingresar al CNE. Así que sus afirmaciones, que presumo de total buena fe, incurren en una falacia que confunde la parte con el todo. Trump Gives Green Light to Saudi Nuclear Program The Donald Trump administration has finalized the draft of a bilateral nuclear agreement that authorizes Saudi Arabia to enrich uranium on its own territory. Although the negotiating teams have completed the terms, the document still awaits Trump’s final signature and approval by the U.S. Congress. This framework breaks with the region’s long-standing non-proliferation rules. Unlike the deal with the United Arab Emirates, which permanently renounced uranium enrichment and plutonium reprocessing while accepting strict IAEA inspections, the agreement with the Saudis does not require Riyadh to adopt the Agency’s inspection regime. Oversight will be limited to a bilateral pact between the United States and Saudi Arabia. This reinforces what Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has already said openly: if Iran gets a nuclear weapon, Saudi Arabia will want one too. It sounds like a clear signal that Riyadh believes Tehran already has, or is very close to having, the bomb, which explains the intense pressure they are putting on Washington. The situation puts the U.S. in a complicated position. Saudi Arabia’s ballistic missile program is developed in partnership with China, complete with technology transfers. If the Americans don’t give in now, the Saudis have plenty of money to look for other partners. This is not just about civilian nuclear energy. For that, it would be enough to buy reactors and import ready-made fuel. What Riyadh really wants is to master the full nuclear fuel cycle, especially domestic uranium enrichment. With this infrastructure, Saudi Arabia is building a nuclear latency capability: it will control the core technology needed to develop a weapon in relatively short order if pushed by an existential threat. TRES PROVINCIAS ARGENTINAS TIENEN MÁS EXPORTACIONES PER CÁPITA QUE EEUU Y OTRAS ECONOMÍAS DESARROLLADAS: CUÁLES SON Y QUÉ EXPORTAN | Por Mariano Zalazar El comercio exterior argentino viene creciendo de forma pronunciada, pero no todas las provincias están logrando “subirse a la ola”. Con sólo analizar el dato de las exportaciones per cápita, se pueden descubrir las grandes diferencias que existen entre algunas jurisdicciones y otras. Algunas logran superar en esa estadística a grandes potencias, como Estados Unidos, mientas que otras se encuentran en una situación completamente opuesta. Para entenderlo mejor, se debe entrar en detalle sobre los números del sector exportador. En 2025, las exportaciones argentinas de bienes totalizaron USD 87.077 millones, según el Indec, con un incremento del 9,3% respecto del año anterior, pero cuando ese desempeño se mide en relación con la población de cada provincia, el mapa cambia. Durante todo 2025, tres provincias patagónicas encabezaron el ranking de exportaciones per cápita del país: Santa Cruz, con USD 8.816 por habitante; Chubut, con USD 6.583; y Neuquén, con USD 6.460. Esos valores se ubicaron por encima de los que registraron, en el mismo año, economías desarrolladas como Estados Unidos (USD 6.441 por habitante) y Japón (USD 5.900), y en el caso de Santa Cruz, también por encima de Nueva Zelanda (USD 6.650), por citar algunos ejemplos. SANTA FE: LA JUSTICIA LIBERÓ A LOS SIETE CADETES PENITENCIARIOS ACUSADOS DE ABUSO SEXUAL CONTRA UN COMPAÑERO Siete cadetes aspirantes al Servicio Penitenciario de la provincia de Santa Fe fueron liberados con restricciones, tras ser acusados de abuso sexual y lesiones contra un compañero dentro de la Escuela Penitenciaria N°7 “Marcos Sánchez”. La jueza del caso, Rosana Carrara, rechazó el pedido de prisión preventiva solicitado por la Fiscalía, en una audiencia de medidas cautelares realizada este viernes en los tribunales de la capital provincial. Ahora bien, la magistrada dio por acreditado que hubo abuso sexual, las lesiones sufridas por la víctima y la expectativa de una pena elevada contra Álvaro J., Michael G., Andrés F., Taiel F., Héctor F., Roque F. y Catriel D., quienes están imputados y presenciaron la resolución desde su lugar de detención, en la Alcaidía de la Unidad Regional I, a través de una videollamada. La víctima de 19 años dio cuenta de las consecuencias que le generó el ataque. Dijo que sintió “bronca” y “vergüenza”, que lo tomaron desprevenido, y le resulta difícil retomar la instrucción porque “todos voltean para mirarme”. “No se les tendría que dar la libertad”, pidió sobre sus atacantes. El MPA respaldó este testimonio con la declaración de tres testigos presenciales. Infobae 📎 infob.ae/4xi33ar

The period is marked by three seasonal shifts: eagles circle more keenly, nature grows austere and grains ripen for harvest. Southern Song Dynasty poet Su Jiong wrote: "Scarcely three days since summer's heat ceased, the fresh chill arrives, priceless as gold." Autumn winds rise. Golden pheasants wander among rocks and crape-myrtle blossoms, foraging at ease. The autumn air is crisp and tranquil, and all things are at peace. Video

EL DIRECTOR DE ALPINE ELOGIÓ A COLAPINTO TRAS ACORTAR DISTANCIAS CON EL AUTO DE GASLY, QUE RECIBIÓ MEJORAS Franco Colapinto completó una correcta actuación en la jornada del sábado en el Gran Premio de Países Bajos de Fórmula 1 al cruzar la bandera a cuadros 12° en la Sprint y quedar 14° en la clasificación. Su buen rendimiento se relaciona, principalmente, por marcar registros similares y acortar la diferencia que tenía con Pierre Gasly en comparación al inicio del fin de semana en Zandvoort, donde el argentino no cuenta con el importante paquete de actualizaciones que está montado en el monoplaza del francés. Al igual que en el cierre del viernes, Steve Nielsen destacó el trabajo de Colapinto y elogió el resultado que concretó al maximizar el rendimiento de su auto sin mejoras. “Franco sacó el máximo partido a todo lo que tenía a su alcance y, una vez más, hizo un trabajo realmente magnífico”, comentó el director de la escudería francesa. El propio Nielsen reconoció en la primera jornada de actividad en pista del GP de Países Bajos que el argentino está en una “circunstancia bastante contrastante” en comparación a la de su compañero, que cuenta con una actualización que representa “una mejora significativa y de gran impacto”. El notable rendimiento de Colapinto también le permitió recortar distancias con su compañero de forma contundente: tras quedar a 0.915 segundos en la FP1, el argentino terminó a solo 0.184 en la Q2 de la qualy. Trump Gives Green Light to Saudi Nuclear Program The Donald Trump administration has finalized the draft of a bilateral nuclear agreement that authorizes Saudi Arabia to enrich uranium on its own territory. Although the negotiating teams have completed the terms, the document still awaits Trump’s final signature and approval by the U.S. Congress. This framework breaks with the region’s long-standing non-proliferation rules. Unlike the deal with the United Arab Emirates, which permanently renounced uranium enrichment and plutonium reprocessing while accepting strict IAEA inspections, the agreement with the Saudis does not require Riyadh to adopt the Agency’s inspection regime. Oversight will be limited to a bilateral pact between the United States and Saudi Arabia. This reinforces what Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has already said openly: if Iran gets a nuclear weapon, Saudi Arabia will want one too. It sounds like a clear signal that Riyadh believes Tehran already has, or is very close to having, the bomb, which explains the intense pressure they are putting on Washington. The situation puts the U.S. in a complicated position. Saudi Arabia’s ballistic missile program is developed in partnership with China, complete with technology transfers. If the Americans don’t give in now, the Saudis have plenty of money to look for other partners. This is not just about civilian nuclear energy. For that, it would be enough to buy reactors and import ready-made fuel. What Riyadh really wants is to master the full nuclear fuel cycle, especially domestic uranium enrichment. With this infrastructure, Saudi Arabia is building a nuclear latency capability: it will control the core technology needed to develop a weapon in relatively short order if pushed by an existential threat. Fue en 1998, cuando el Autódromo Oscar y Juan Gálvez vio ganar al piloto de Ferrari, Michael Schumacher. Desde entonces, Buenos Aires quedó afuera del calendario que la FIA, la Federación Internacional del Automóvil, dispone para organizar el campeonato más popular de ese deporte. Eso podría cambiar en los próximos años. A partir del próximo 31 de agosto, la Ciudad recibirá el Congreso Americano FIA 2026, que se extenderá al miércoles 3 de septiembre y podría ser el gesto definitivo que marque el regreso de Argentina como sede del calendario de la Fórmula 1. Este evento regional volverá a hacerse en el país después de 15 años y tendrá como institución anfitriona al Automóvil Club Argentino (ACA), que actúa como representante oficial de la FIA, que ya confirmó la asistencia de su presidente, Mohammed ben Sulayem. La novedad que Infobae pudo confirmar en las últimas horas es que quien irá a la inauguración del congreso será el presidente Javier Milei. “Está confirmado”, indicó una fuente inobjetable que trabaja en la organización de esa apertura, que lo tendrá como encabezando con un discurso ese lunes a las 11 de la mañana luego de las disertaciones de ben Sulayem y el titular del ACA, César Carman. También está prevista la participación de la secretaria general de la Presidencia, Karina Milei; el ministro de Relaciones Exteriores, Pablo Quirno; y el secretario de Turismo, Ambiente y Deportes, Daniel Scioli. VIDEO | Gujarat: Four members of the same family, including two children were killed after a blast took place while unloading scrap from a mini-truck. Superintendent of Police, Vikas Sunda said, "This evening, in the Vafat Nagar area of Kothada village in Nakhatrana taluka of Kutch, two brothers, Ahmed Kumbhar (30) and Noor Mohammad Kumbhar (26), who work as local scrap dealers, returned home after their routine collection rounds in the nearby area. While unloading items from their small commercial vehicle ('Chhota Hathi') parked behind their house, a sudden blast occurred. Both brothers died on the spot. Two young children playing nearby were rushed to the hospital, where they were also declared dead. Forensic Crime Scene officials are set to visit the site shortly, followed by explosive specialists who will thoroughly investigate the exact cause and nature of the blast. Primary visual inspection of the rear section of the vehicle suggests that the explosion caused the diesel tank to rupture; however, explosive experts will provide a definitive assessment following their technical examination." भाई तू ज़्यादा टेंशन मत ले। मुझे पता है जबसे लात मारके निकाले गये हो, परेशान हो। लोग पंजाब के शानदार स्कूलों के विडियो बना बनाकर पोस्ट कर रहे हैं तो हम क्या करें? लो ये वाला देखो आज ही सोशल मीडिया पर मिला। Video Amit Malviya (@amitmalviya) Arvind Kejriwal’s latest sermon on education is the same old playbook: spend heavily on advertising, showcase a few isolated projects and then sell the exception as the norm. That is not an education model. It is a perception-management model. Delhi saw it first. A handful of heavily publicised schools were presented as proof that an entire government-school system had been transformed. But education cannot be judged by school facades, photo-ops or advertisements. It must be judged by what children actually learn. The data is far less flattering. ASER 2024 found significant improvement in learning levels in states such as Uttar Pradesh and Gujarat, while noting declines in government-school reading levels in Punjab. Punjab may have improved in some foundational measures, but the state continues to face serious structural problems: thousands of teacher vacancies, hundreds of pending infrastructure projects, villages without schools and a “worrisome” higher-secondary enrolment ratio flagged by the Union Education Ministry. Contrast this with the BJP’s approach: build infrastructure at scale, strengthen teachers, introduce technology and measure learning outcomes, not manufacture a myth around a few showcase schools. PM SHRI, for instance, combines modern infrastructure with ICT, laboratories, sports, teacher development and tracking of every child’s learning progress. Gujarat, Goa, Puducherry and Uttar Pradesh are examples of this broader approach. Uttar Pradesh’s government schools saw Class V children able to read Class II-level text rise by 15 percentage points between 2018 and 2024, while overall basic arithmetic rose from 26.9% to 40.7%. Gujarat too recorded notable improvement in government-school learning levels. The real test of education is simple: Are children learning? Are teachers available? Are classrooms, laboratories, libraries, toilets and digital facilities reaching ordinary schools, not just showcase institutions? Kejriwal tried to turn Delhi’s education story into a political brand. Delhi rejected that politics of claims over delivery. Now he is trying the same formula in Punjab. The script is familiar. The advertising comes first. The reality catches up later. Delhi showed the way out. Punjab will follow. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/amitmalviya/status/2091105834994679952#m

Today, Zelenskyy, Starmer, Macron, and Merz meet in London. The format itself is worth welcoming, even if the EU has once again been left on the sidelines. The real question is what mindset the E3 brings to the table. Zelenskyy set the tone with his open letter to Putin. While his European partners likely share its substance, they are unlikely to be ready to openly put their signatures beneath it. But they do see that Russia is not looking for middle ground. It is set on war. Seeking a balanced compromise with an aggressor committed to conquest is not diplomacy. It is self-deception. The predecessors of today’s leaders understood this well. Symbolically, eighty-five years ago, London hosted another gathering. In June 1941, representatives of fourteen Allied governments and liberation movements met there to unite against Nazism. The final London Declaration was not about ending a war. It was about uniting those willing to win it and shape the peace that followed. One can only hope today’s meeting is guided by the same logic. Europe’s prosperity depends on its security. Europe’s security depends on Ukraine. It is time to turn that truth into effective policy. And fast.

The Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, has constituted a high-level Committee under the chairmanship of former Deputy National Security Advisor and Interlocutor Shri Pankaj Kumar Singh to prepare the comprehensive framework for a Permanent Political Solution with regards to Gorkha issues under the aegis of Constitution of India. This decisive step represents a major and long-awaited breakthrough in resolving this critical pending matter.

Held a meeting with Gorkha Member of Parliament, MLAs, and prominent Political Leaders along with CM of West Bengal in Siliguri today. Discussed the long-pending aspirations and genuine concerns of the Gorkha people and a practical roadmap forward. Reiterated that under the leadership of PM Modi Ji, the government is firmly committed to addressing these issues. Further assured them that every possible effort will be made to address their legitimate aspirations within the framework of the Constitution. Thanked them for participating in the meeting and sharing their valuable suggestions. The government will work towards a just, dignified, and lasting resolution that honours the aspirations of the Gorkha community, safeguards their identity and ensures a better future.

Agnes Kaposi was just 11 years old when she was forced to work on a state farm in Austria contributing to Nazi agricultural production. Still a child, she was later sent to an armaments plant, where she moved materials around a factory producing anti-aircraft guns. Born to a Jewish family in Hungary, Kaposi was one of an estimated 20 million men, women and children exploited by the Nazis’ vast apparatus of forced and slave labor — an often-overlooked topic in wider Holocaust remembrance and commemoration that is now the focus of a major exhibition in London this summer. “Nazi Slave Labor: Perpetrators and Victims” runs through the end of October at the Wiener Holocaust Library. It highlights the breadth and development of the system, which stretched from the Atlantic coast of occupied France to the Eastern Front in the Soviet Union. Read more on The Times of Israel.

Je me suis entretenu avec le Président @ZelenskyyUa au lendemain de la double frappe russe en plein jour contre un centre commercial à Kryvyi Rih, qui a fait de très nombreuses victimes civiles. Je lui ai dit notre horreur et notre émotion. Avec ces frappes et celles cette semaine contre Kyiv, la Russie poursuit et aggrave le crime de son agression. En visant systématiquement des civils, et en faisant le choix de l'intimidation et de l'escalade, la Russie cherche probablement à projeter la force mais signe surtout un aveu de faiblesse. Il est crucial, dans ce contexte, de donner à l'Ukraine tous les moyens nécessaires pour défendre son ciel et faire échec à cette agression. J'ai annoncé au Président Zelensky le renforcement de notre soutien, avec l'envoi d'intercepteurs et la poursuite de notre coopération dans le droit fil de la réunion de lancement de la Coalition antibalistique qui s'est tenue à Paris le 13 juillet dernier et de la déclaration d'intention signée le 17 novembre 2025. Il est essentiel que tous les pays qui ont des moyens en leur possession se joignent aussi à cet effort. Nous devons également continuer d'augmenter la pression sur la Russie tant qu'elle fera le choix de refuser l'arrêt des combats et la paix. Nous avons aussi fait le point, dans la perspective de la réunion de la Coalition des Volontaires qui se tiendra ce lundi, sur notre mobilisation pour faire advenir cette paix à laquelle le peuple ukrainien aspire légitimement, dans le respect de ses droits et avec toutes les garanties de sécurité pour l'Ukraine et pour notre continent. La Russie cherche à faire plier l’Ukraine par la terreur : elle n’y parviendra pas. Tous unis aux côtés de l’Ukraine, nous ferons prévaloir le droit et la justice sur la force.

#WATCH | Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh: Tinkle Karga Gongo’s mother, Aiyum Karde, says, “It all started when my daughter came to me asking for money to buy ice cream...I took her out to buy the ice cream, and we spoke in Hindi there; Tinkle spoke Hindi too. My dad is Indian too, and so am I." She insisted that I make and post a video about it immediately. So, I made the video. युवाशक्तीच्या साथीने नशामुक्त नवी मुंबईचा संकल्प मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते आज नवी मुंबई पोलीस आयुक्तालयाच्या नशामुक्त नवी मुंबई अभियानाअंतर्गत 'कॅम्पस कनेक्ट' उपक्रमाचा शुभारंभ करण्यात आला. व्यसनांपासून दूर राहून विद्यार्थ्यांनी शिक्षण, क्रीडा, कौशल्यविकास आणि राष्ट्रउभारणीकडे वळावे, असे आवाहन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, आजच्या तरुण पिढीमध्ये अमली पदार्थांचे वाढते आकर्षण आणि त्याचे होणारे गंभीर सामाजिक, शारीरिक व मानसिक परिणाम लक्षात घेता, नवी मुंबई पोलिसांनी या उपक्रमाच्या माध्यमातून विद्यार्थ्यांपर्यंत थेट पोहोचण्याचा प्रयत्न केला आहे. महाविद्यालयीन परिसर हा युवकांच्या व्यक्तिमत्त्व विकासाचा महत्त्वाचा टप्पा असल्याने, या वयोगटात योग्य माहिती व जागरूकता निर्माण करणे हे या मोहिमेचे प्रमुख उद्दिष्ट आहे. भारताच्या 'डेमोग्राफिक डिव्हिडंड'चा उल्लेख करत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, देशाची 65% युवाशक्ती ही आपली मोठी ताकद आहे. या युवाशक्तीला निष्प्रभ करण्यासाठी शत्रू राष्ट्रे आणि असामाजिक घटक तरुणांना व्यसनाच्या आहारी घालण्याचे षडयंत्र रचत आहेत. या लढाईत अमली पदार्थांची पुरवठा साखळी पूर्णपणे नेस्तनाबूत करणे आणि तरुणांमध्ये जागृती निर्माण करून मागणी संपवणे, असा सर्वांगीण दृष्टिकोन ही काळाची गरज आहे. 'नो टू ड्रग्स'चा संदेश स्वामी विवेकानंदांच्या विचारांचा दाखला देत, योग्य दिशेने गेलेली युवाशक्ती समाजासाठी 'ऑक्सिजन' बनून संजीवनी देते, असे प्रतिपादन करत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, प्रत्येक शैक्षणिक कॅम्पस हे या लढाईचे केंद्र असून प्रत्येक विद्यार्थी या नशाविरोधी मोहिमेचा सैनिक आहे. व्यसनांपासून दूर राहून विद्यार्थ्यांनी शिक्षण, क्रीडा, कौशल्यविकास आणि राष्ट्रउभारणीकडे वळावे. व्यसनाच्या गर्तेत अडकलेल्या विद्यार्थ्यांना भेदभाव न करता व्यसनमुक्ती केंद्रांच्या माध्यमातून मदत केली जाईल. पोलीस, महानगरपालिका, नागरिक आणि तरुणाईच्या संयुक्त प्रयत्नांतून नवी मुंबईला पूर्णपणे नशामुक्त आणि सुरक्षित बनवण्याचा संकल्प या वेळी सोडण्यात आला. तरुणाईच्या साथीने 'सुजलाम सुफलाम' व विकसित भारताचे स्वप्न पूर्ण होईल, असा विश्वास मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केला. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते व्यसनमुक्ती पुनर्वसन केंद्र व व्यसनमुक्त चित्रफितीचे लोकार्पणही करण्यात आले. तसेच, या अभियानानिमित्त आयोजित जनजागृतीपर पोस्टर्स व रील्स स्पर्धेत निवडलेल्या सर्वोत्तम प्रत्येकी तीन विद्यार्थ्यांना मुख्यमंत्र्यांच्या हस्ते प्रमाणपत्र देऊन गौरविण्यात आले. यावेळी मंत्री गणेश नाईक, मंत्री भरत गोगावले, आमदार विक्रांत पाटील, आमदार रविंद्र फाटक, आमदार मंदा म्हात्रे, आमदार महेश बालदी व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @NaikSpeaks @ibharatgogawale @ivikrantpatil @iravindraphatak @MlaMandaMhatre @mlamaheshbaldi #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #NaviMumbai

3/3 The bigger issue is numbers. Mirage-2000, Jaguar and MiG-29 fleets will retire through the 2030s. AMCA cannot replace that mass overnight. India will need stealth at the sharp end and affordable 4.5-gen fighters providing volume behind it. Air defence, escort, maritime strike, standoff attack and routine high-sortie missions do not all require a stealth aircraft. By 2035, Tejas Mk-2’s relevance will be decided less by its “generation” tag and more by its weapons, EW, sensors, networking, availability and integration into India’s kill-web.

2/3 Tejas Mk-2 will sit inside a much larger kill-web: Netra Mk-2, satellites, HAPS and UAVs detect. CATS/Ghatak penetrate, jam and scout. Astra Mk-3 reaches deep into enemy airspace. BrahMos-NG and other standoff weapons strike without crossing into dense SAM zones. Mk-2 becomes a networked shooter, not a lone hunter.

1/3 Air Marshal (Retd) Nagesh Kapoor is right on the core issue: the IAF cannot keep waiting indefinitely. Delays have operational costs. But dismissing Tejas Mk-2 as irrelevant by 2035 assumes it must fight China’s stealth fighters alone. That is not how a 2035 air war will be fought.

When conditions change, rural businesses need to respond quickly. Timely advice can make the difference when pests, crop diseases or other shocks threaten months of work. Yet where extension services are overstretched, that support may take weeks to arrive - time that small-scale producers and agripreneurs cannot afford to lose. In Nigeria, the IFAD-funded LIFE-ND project introduced artificial intelligence (#AI) to help address pressure on extension services. Through a partnership with Digital Green, the project enabled farmers to access FarmerChat, an AI-powered agricultural advisory service. Available in ten languages, the chatbot provides real-time agricultural information to agripreneurs in rural areas. This has made it easier to respond to setbacks, helping strengthen the stability and predictability of rural enterprises, while contributing to higher earnings. In Cambodia, the IFAD-funded ASPIRE programme supported the use of digital extension services, e-learning platforms and a mobile application to improve the flow of information to farmers. As a result, participating farmers saw revenues increase by 60%. By working with governments, the private sector and development partners, IFAD invests in ICT4D and digital agriculture to accelerate rural transformation, raise agricultural productivity and expand access to markets. Our strategic vision for advancing digital agriculture for rural transformation prioritizes: - Integrating farmer registries and digital public infrastructure to strengthen agricultural systems - Leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) and data to enhance extension and advisory services - Enabling small-scale producers to access finance, inputs and markets more efficiently Read more about IFAD’s work on ICT4D and digital agriculture at ifad.org/en/w/publications/t… #FinancingTheFirstMile

THREE’S A CROWD 🌀 PAGASA is now monitoring three weather disturbances again around the Philippine area of responsibility, Saturday afternoon. The remnant low pressure area of #NenengPH re-developed into a tropical depression, with international name Gaenari. At 3 p.m., Gaenari was located 660 km north northeast of Itbayat, Batanes, outside the PAR. It is not expected to re-enter the PAR, according to PAGASA. Meanwhile, the LPA east of Mindanao also developed into a tropical depression Saturday morning. It was located 1,055 km east of Eastern Visayas at 3 p.m. A brief PAR entry is not ruled out as the depression will eventually move northeastward due to interaction with the stronger Typhoon Saudel. It will be assigned the local name #ObetPH when it enters the PAR. Saudel has crossed Northern Mariana Islands, now packing winds of 150 kph with gusts up to 185 kph. It was located more than 2,500 km east of Northern Luzon Saturday afternoon. Saudel may intensify further before entering the northeastern corner of the Philippine area of responsibility on Monday. It will be assigned the name #PilandokPH. The typhoon will remain far from the country but will enhance the southwest monsoon or Habagat towards next weekend. | via @arielrojasPH

Your phone started as rocks. So did your laptop, your car battery, and the jumbotron displaying your favorite team’s score. Before any of that technology existed, the raw materials inside it (minerals!) had to be found and understood. Minerals are naturally occurring substances with specific chemical compositions and crystal structures. They form through the Earth’s natural processes and are the building blocks of the rocks beneath our feet. Some minerals are especially important to modern life and the technologies we rely on every day, many of which are critical minerals. Critical minerals are both essential to the Nation’s economy or national security AND have supply chains that are vulnerable to disruptions, such as changes in trade, natural disasters, or global instability. The USGS leads the U.S. government in developing the List of Critical Minerals. USGS scientists study how and where these minerals form, and collect and analyze data on global production, demand, trade, and recycling to identify risks to mineral supply chains that sometimes span the globe. The USGS also delivers essential science to inform questions like: 🪨Where might undiscovered resources be, and how much? 🪨Is there critical mineral potential in waste materials left over from mining? 🪨How do critical minerals move through air, water, and soil? From rock to resource, USGS science helps decision makers, industries, and the public better understand the materials that power our world. To learn more about USGS critical minerals science, visit ow.ly/b2Up50ZCHck 📷 1: Critical Minerals. Clockwise from top center: praseodymium, cerium, lanthanum, neodymium, samarium, and gadolinium. Dandong, in northeast China's Liaoning Province, is a rare border city where rivers, seas, mountains, forests, and wetlands sit side by side. Its strategic port and rich coastal ecosystem have made it a gateway for high-quality trade and frontier growth. From marine ranches and eco-friendly aquaculture to specialized agriculture and port-related logistics, the city is turning its natural endowment into real-world opportunity. As China's largest border city, Dandong is also a key link in the country's transport network. It sits at the start of two major national routes: G228 and G331, which are part of a 27,000-kilometer loop being completed during the 15th Five-Year Plan (2026–2030) that also includes highway G219. These highways plug Dandong's sea ranches, farms, and port industries directly into the national logistics network – a lifeline for the region and beyond. Taking immediate cognizance of the incident, a joint team comprising the local police and the Crime Branch was formed to investigate. We obtained leads from students who had received the paper, revealing a connection to Bharti College in Durg, affiliated with the university. A professor from the university was responsible for transporting the question paper from the university in a sealed envelope. He made a small hole at the bottom of the envelope, inserted an endoscopic camera to scan the entire paper, manually transcribed 15 questions, and sold these copied questions to students. A Lifetime of Service Deserves a Lifetime of Care 🐾 CM Devendra Fadnavis has taken a compassionate decision regarding police dogs that have completed 10 years of service. Even after their retirement from active service, these loyal companions will continue to remain with the Police Department. Over the course of their service, a deep bond of trust, affection and companionship develops between police dogs and their handlers. However, adopting them out after retirement can often affect their emotional well-being, with some even refusing to eat after being separated from their familiar surroundings and handlers. Recognising this, CM Devendra Fadnavis has emphasised that caring for these faithful friends who have served the Police Department is a responsibility that must be upheld. These retired police dogs will continue to stay with the Police Department, ensuring that their enduring bond with their handlers remains intact and that they can spend their remaining years in comfort and care. भारतीय जनता पार्टी ने आज 22 अगस्त 2026 को वंदे मातरम् के सम्मान और उसकी ऐतिहासिक विरासत की रक्षा के संबंध में एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रस्ताव पारित किया। भारतीय जनता पार्टी 19 अगस्त 2026 को कांग्रेस कार्यसमिति द्वारा 1937 के अपने प्रस्ताव को पुनः स्वीकार करते हुए कांग्रेस के कार्यक्रमों में ‘वन्दे मातरम्’ के केवल प्रथम दो पदों के गायन को सीमित करने के निर्णय की कड़ी निंदा और स्पष्ट शब्दों में विरोध करती है। भाजपा वन्दे मातरम् को भारत का राष्ट्रीय गीत, भारत माता के प्रति श्रद्धा की अभिव्यक्ति, स्वतंत्रता संग्राम का मंत्र और भारत की राष्ट्रीय चेतना का अमर प्रतीक मानती है। अतः भारतीय जनता पार्टी संकल्प करती है: 1. 19 अगस्त 2026 को कांग्रेस कार्यसमिति द्वारा 1937 के प्रस्ताव को दोहराते हुए वन्दे मातरम् के प्रथम दो पदों तक गायन सीमित करने के निर्णय की कड़ी निंदा और स्पष्ट विरोध करेगी। 2. पूर्ण वन्दे मातरम् के सम्मान, गरिमा, विरासत और राष्ट्रीय स्वरूप की रक्षा करेगी, इसे भारत का राष्ट्रीय गीत, राष्ट्रीय चेतना का अमर प्रतीक और स्वतंत्रता संग्राम की गौरवशाली विरासत मानेगी। 3. 1950 में संविधान सभा की घोषणा तथा 2026 में संसद द्वारा राष्ट्रीय गीत को जन गण मन के समान वैधानिक संरक्षण प्रदान किए जाने से स्थापित स्थिति की दृढ़ता से पुष्टि करेगी। 4. राष्ट्रीय गीत को सांप्रदायिक दबाव, राजनीतिक तुष्टीकरण अथवा संकीर्ण वोट-बैंक की राजनीति के अधीन करने के हर प्रयास का विरोध करेगी। 5. कांग्रेस को स्मरण कराएगी कि उसकी कार्यसमिति का कोई प्रस्ताव भारत के संवैधानिक संस्थानों और संसद द्वारा बनाए गए कानूनों से ऊपर नहीं हो सकता। 1937 का राजनीतिक समझौता 1950 के संवैधानिक निर्णय और 2026 में संसद द्वारा बनाए गए कानून से ऊपर नहीं रखा जा सकता। 6. जनता के सामने उस ऐतिहासिक और राजनीतिक संदर्भ को उजागर करेगी, जिसमें वन्दे मातरम् के गायन को सीमित किया गया था, जिसमें मुस्लिम लीग की आपत्तियां तथा बाद में बढ़ती सांप्रदायिक और अलगाववादी मांगों की राजनीति शामिल थी। 7. महात्मा गांधी के उस ऐतिहासिक कथन को जन-जन तक पहुंचाएगी, जिसमें उन्होंने वन्दे मातरम् को “साम्राज्यवाद-विरोधी नारा” और “शुद्धतम राष्ट्रीय भावना” से जुड़ा हुआ बताया था। 8. भाजपा कार्यकर्ताओं के माध्यम से देशव्यापी अभियान चलाएगी, जिसके अंतर्गत वन्दे मातरम् का इतिहास, अर्थ, राष्ट्रीय महत्व और गौरवशाली विरासत भारत के हर कोने तक पहुंचाई जाएगी। 9. विशेषकर युवा पीढ़ी के बीच जागरूकता का अभियान चलाया जाएगा, ताकि छह पदों वाले पूर्ण राष्ट्रीय गीत और उसके इतिहास को विस्मृति में न जाने दिया जाए तथा आने वाली पीढ़ियां समझ सकें कि वन्दे मातरम् के साथ भारत की स्वतंत्रता, संघर्ष, बलिदान और राष्ट्र-जागरण की कितनी गहरी स्मृतियां जुड़ी हैं। 10. राजनीतिक सुविधा या तुष्टीकरण के लिए वन्दे मातरम् के सम्मान और विरासत से किसी भी प्रकार का समझौता स्वीकार नहीं किया जाएगा। यह केवल किसी राजनीतिक दल से जुड़ा विषय नहीं है। यह भारत के सम्मान और उन असंख्य देशभक्तों की विरासत का प्रश्न है, जिन्होंने राष्ट्र की स्वतंत्रता के लिए अपना सर्वस्व न्योछावर कर दिया। भारतीय जनता पार्टी देशवासियों से आह्वान करती है कि वे स्मरण रखें - वन्दे मातरम् के शब्द कभी इतने शक्तिशाली थे कि एक साम्राज्य उनसे भयभीत हो उठा था। अंग्रेजों ने इन्हें दबाने का प्रयास इसलिए किया क्योंकि इन शब्दों ने प्रतिरोध की चेतना जगाई थी। पीढ़ियों के भारतीयों ने इन्हें स्वतंत्रता, बलिदान और राष्ट्रगौरव के मंत्र के रूप में अपनाया। इस विरासत को आज की वोट-बैंक राजनीति की गणित में सीमित नहीं किया जा सकता। 1947 में भारत की स्वतंत्रता का जयघोष 'वंदे मातरम्' था, और आदरणीय प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेंद्र मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में 2047 के 'विकसित भारत' का महाघोष भी 'वंदे मातरम्' ही होगा। वन्दे मातरम्।

Today, on 22nd August 2026, the Bharatiya Janata Party passed an important resolution regarding the honour and protection of the historical legacy of Vande Mataram. The Bharatiya Janata Party strongly condemns and unequivocally opposes the decision taken by the Congress Working Committee on 19th August 2026 to reaffirm its 1937 resolution and restrict the singing of Vande Mataram to its first two stanzas at Congress programmes. The Bharatiya Janata Party regards Vande Mataram as the National Song of Bharat, an expression of reverence for Bharat Mata, a mantra of the freedom struggle and an immortal symbol of India’s national consciousness. The Bharatiya Janata Party therefore resolves: 1. To strongly condemn and unequivocally oppose the Congress Working Committee’s decision of 19th August 2026 to reaffirm its 1937 resolution and restrict Vande Mataram to its first two stanzas at Congress programmes. 2. To uphold the honour, dignity, legacy and national status of the complete Vande Mataram as the National Song of Bharat and as an immortal symbol of India’s national consciousness and freedom struggle. 3. To affirm the constitutional and statutory status of Vande Mataram as established by the Constituent Assembly’s 1950 pronouncement and reinforced by Parliament’s 2026 amendment extending statutory protection to the National Song equivalent to that accorded to the National Anthem. 4. To reject every attempt to subordinate the National Song to communal pressure, political appeasement or narrow vote-bank considerations. 5. To remind the Congress that a resolution of its Working Committee cannot override the constitutional institutions or laws of the Republic of India, and that a political compromise of 1937 cannot be elevated above the constitutional settlement of 1950 and legislation enacted by Parliament in 2026. 6. To expose before the people of Bharat the historical and political context in which the truncation of Vande Mataram took place, including the objections raised by the Muslim League and the subsequent politics of communal and separatist demands. 7. To recall and disseminate Mahatma Gandhi’s own testimony that Vande Mataram had become an “anti-imperialist cry” and that he associated it with “the purest national spirit”, demonstrating its larger national meaning beyond the literary or religious context of particular stanzas. 8. To undertake a nationwide campaign through BJP Karyakartas to take the history, meaning, national significance and glorious legacy of Vande Mataram to every corner of Bharat. 9. To educate and mobilise the people, especially the younger generation, so that the complete six-stanza National Song and its history are not forgotten and future generations understand the sacrifices, struggles and patriotic awakening with which Vande Mataram is inseparably associated. 10. To affirm that no compromise can be accepted with the honour and legacy of Vande Mataram for political convenience or appeasement. This is not merely a matter concerning a political party. It concerns the honour of Bharat and the legacy of countless patriots who sacrificed for the freedom of the nation. The BJP calls upon every citizen to remember that the words Vande Mataram were once powerful enough to frighten an empire. The British sought to suppress them because they awakened resistance. Generations of Indians carried them as a mantra of freedom, sacrifice and national pride. That legacy cannot be reduced to the calculations of contemporary vote-bank politics. The same 'Vande Mataram' that echoed as the call for freedom in 1947 will resound as the supreme chant for a 'Developed India @ 2047’ under the vision of Hon'ble PM Shri Narendra Modi Ji. वन्दे मातरम्।

I write for @SwarajyaMag on how the Government of India, instead of improving its departments’ record in contractual discipline, has instead decided to drop arbitration & make dispute resolution and enforcement of contract difficult to discourage contractors for raising disputes. Swarajya (@SwarajyaMag) The National Highways Authority of India lost about $3.5 billion in arbitration between 2015 and 2025, out of claims worth around $10.78 billion. - The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, which runs NHAI, responded by taking arbitration out of its contracts. - It ordered arbitration clauses removed for any dispute above Rs 10 crore. Not only in new contracts, but in existing ones as well. An arbitration clause means any dispute under the contract goes to a private tribunal instead of a court. Contractors ask for it because Indian courts take years. Take it out, and a company with a claim against the government is left with: - a mediation panel the government itself picks, or - the district court queue The Ministry of Rural Development has gone further. Its contracts now say there will be no arbitration at all. All this while the conferences carry on. Every few weeks the government, the bar and the bench meet to announce that India is about to become the world's next arbitration hub. The same thing has happened with India's investment treaties, which promise foreign investors fair treatment and a way to enforce it. In 2016 the finance ministry rewrote the template for these treaties after which India cancelled 74 of the ones it already had. Nine are still in force, and only one is with a G-20 country. So, nearly every large economy that invests in India now does so without such a treaty. The arbitration law itself has been amended five times since 2014, some of it with retrospective effect. Parts of those amendments cleared Parliament, got presidential assent and were printed in the gazette. They were then never brought into force. A sixth has been drafted but not introduced. A company signing a contract today cannot be sure which version of the law will govern a dispute under it. The courts have added to the problem. An arbitral award is meant to be near final, open to challenge only on narrow grounds. But awards that had run out of appeals have still been set aside by the Supreme Court. The delays in Indian courts are no secret. That is also what makes them useful. A company that knows its claim will take a decade may decide not to file it. افغانستان (که یکسره پشتونی بوده‌اند) بهترین گواه بر مظلومیت اقوام دیگر از جمله هزاره‌ها است. پس وقتی کاتب تاریخ سلطه‌ی افغانی را می‌نویسد، تاریخ مردم هزاره را نیز نوشته است. لحن تند سلطانی نسبت به کاتب اصل بی‌طرفی در قضاوت را زیر سؤال می‌برد و مسائل را خلط و شلغم‌شوربا می‌کند. اگر فرض کنیم که کاتب وفادار به دولت وقت است، دولتی بودن کاتب به نوشته و قلم او اعتبار والاتر می‌دهد؛ زیرا آن دولت و آن «اوباشان آنلاین» الزاما گروهی سازمان‌یافته از افراد خشن نیستند؛ این تعبیر بیشتر به نوعی رفتار اشاره دارد: کاربری که به‌ جای استدلال، توهین می‌کند؛ به‌ جای نقد، شخصیت طرف مقابل را هدف می‌گیرد و به‌ جای گفت‌وگو، حذف و تحقیر دیگری را انتخاب می‌کند. مسأله زمانی جدی‌تر می‌شود که این رفتار از یک فرد به گروهی از کاربران سرایت کند و خشونت کلامی، نه یک استثنا، بلکه بخشی از زبان رایج فضای آنلاین جامعه‌ی ما دانسته شود. پرسش اساسی این است: چرا فضای مجازی تا این اندازه مستعد بازتولید خشونت کلامی است؟ پاسخ آن را نمی‌توان تنها در «بی‌ادبی کاربران» جست‌وجو کرد. بلکه عواملی چون روان‌شناسی فرد، ساختار گروه‌های اجتماعی، احساس هویت جمعی، ناشناسی کاربران و حتا سازوکار پلتفرم‌های اجتماعی، همگی در شکل‌گیری این پدیده نقش دارند. در چنین شرایطی، فرد نه‌تنها از خشونت دیگران می‌آموزد، بلکه از واکنش جمع نیز یاد می‌گیرد که چه نوع زبانی در این فضا پاداش می‌گیرد. از همین‌جا «اوباشی‌گری آنلاین» می‌تواند از یک رفتار فردی به یک رفتار جمعی تبدیل شود. دیگر مسأله فقط یک کاربر خشمگین نیست؛ مسأله شبکه‌ای از کاربرانی است که یکدیگر را در استفاده از زبان تهاجمی تقویت می‌کنند. پژوهش‌های جدید نیز نشان می‌دهند که کاربران ممکن است میزان خشم و خصومت موجود در شبکه‌های اجتماعی را بیش از اندازه واقعی تصور کنند. این برداشت می‌تواند تصور افراد از خصومت میان گروه‌ها را تشدید کند و فضای ارتباطی را خصمانه‌تر نشان دهد (برَیدی و همکاران، ۲۰۲۳). بیشتر بخوانید: storage.googleapis.com/quriu…

عبدالله (نام مستعار)، یکی از باشندگان ولسوالی حصه اول پنجشیر، به روزنامه اطلاعات روز گفت که خطیب مسجد در نماز جمعه از همه‌ی باشندگان خواسته بود به این مراسم بروند و همبستگی و حمایت خود را از «امارت اسلامی طالبان» اعلام کنند. عبدالله در ابتدا این درخواست را جدی نگرفت و به آن اعتنایی نکرد؛ اما پس از آن، ملک روستا به مردم هشدار داد که باید شماری از باشندگان در مراسم تجلیل از پنجمین سالگرد قدرت گرفتن طالبان شرکت کنند تا غیبت‌شان به معنای مخالفت با «امارت اسلامی طالبان» تلقی نشود. عبدالله گفت: «وقتی از خطیب مسجد جامع و همچنین ملک روستا شنیدیم که باید به محفل طالبان شرکت کنیم، همگی ما مشوره کردیم و دل ما نمی‌خواست که به این محفل برویم. روز سقوط کابل روزی است که تمام آرزوهای ما به خاک یکسان شد و کار و آزادی را طالبان از ما گرفتند. حالا هم طالبان با مردم پنجشیر رفتار خصمانه دارند و با همه‌ی این‌ها به اجبار مجبور به شرکت در مراسم طالبان شدیم.» به‌گفته‌ی عبدالله، ملک روستا بار دیگر به تمامی باشندگان تأکید کرد که در مراسم پنجمین سالگرد طالبان شرکت کنند تا از افزایش فشار این گروه بر مردم روستا جلوگیری شود. او افزود: «ملک روستا به من گفت که از ولسوالی که به من زنگ زده بودند گفتند اگر کسی به مجلس حاضر نشد، به این معنا است که او مخالف نظام است و با آنان برخورد خواهد شد، رفتن ما از نرفتن ما بهتر است.» عبدالله همراه با ده‌ها نفر دیگر از باشندگان روستا مجبور شد در مراسم طالبان شرکت کند. طالبان از آنان خواستند هنگام رفتن شعارهای «زنده باد امارت اسلامی»، «زنده باد امیرالمؤمنین» و «استقلال مبارک» سر دهند؛ اما به‌گفته‌ی عبدالله، تنها شمار اندکی از مردم از ترس طالبان این شعارها را تکرار کردند. عبدالله از شرکت در این مراسم پشیمان است؛ اما می‌گوید هیچ گزینه‌ی دیگری نداشته و نمی‌خواسته است طالبان او را به حمایت از مخالفان نظامی این گروه متهم کنند. به‌همین‌دلیل، ناچار شده است در مراسم شرکت کند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/259563

In a recent article in @thewire_in, @SaonRay, Senior Visiting Professor, ICRIER explains how the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) is reshaping Indian MSMEs, turning the carbon tax into a non-tariff measure. With CBAM now in its payment phase, Indian steel exporters face extensive monitoring, reporting and verification requirements that function, in effect, as a non-tariff barrier. As Ray notes, these administrative costs are independent of the tariff itself and, for MSMEs, may exceed the carbon payment. The article also mentions ICRIER’s working paper, “Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM): Impact on India’s Steel Exports to the EU and Carbon Tax Incidence” which estimates CBAM could cut India's steel exports to the EU by around 24%, with the burden falling largely on Indian exporters, even as the biggest hurdle for small firms is proving their emissions, not reducing them. Ray frames India's Carbon Credit Trading Scheme as the foundation of long-term carbon governance rather than a quick fix, one that will work only if paired with robust MRV systems, affordable transition finance and targeted capacity-building for MSMEs. Alem, en la provincia de Misiones, acusado de ser el presunto responsable de la muerte de Omar Gabriel Pereyra, de 57 años, cuyo cuerpo apareció el jueves por la mañana a la vera del arroyo Arréame, sobre la calle Primera Junta, entre la avenida Libertad y la calle Independencia. La causa, que en un principio se investigaba como muerte por causa dudosa, pasó a caratularse como homicidio tras el avance de las pesquisas. El hallazgo del cuerpo se produjo cerca de las 11:30 del jueves. Al llegar al lugar, el médico policial constató heridas contusas en distintas regiones de la cabeza, un hematoma en la zona precordial y epistaxis. Ante la presencia de esas lesiones, el profesional solicitó la realización de una autopsia médico-legal para determinar con precisión la causa del fallecimiento. Mientras tanto, peritos de la División Policía Científica realizaron el relevamiento técnico del lugar y el levantamiento de elementos que se incorporaron al expediente. La investigación tomó un rumbo distinto a partir del trabajo de los efectivos de la Unidad Regional VI, que recurrieron a declaraciones testimoniales y al análisis de registros de cámaras de seguridad. Esas diligencias permitieron establecer que el ahora detenido, identificado como Sandro Lizardo F., habría sido la última persona en estar con la víctima. Infobae 📎 infob.ae/4xecK9J

5/5 Ukraine showed everyone the same thing: Buying drones is easy. Building the operators, maintenance, EW protection, data links and command structure around them is harder. That’s the bigger story behind Baaz + Ashni + Divyastra. The Indian Army isn’t adding a gadget. It’s changing how formations fight. 🇮🇳

4/5 The plumbing matters too. SANJAY helps fuse battlefield surveillance. SHAKTI/ACCCS connects artillery command and fire control. So instead of information crawling through multiple voice calls, targeting data can move much faster across the network. That’s where drones become part of a kill chain.

3/5 BAAZ looks deeper. Long-range drones can watch enemy movement, locate high-value targets and feed the wider battle picture. That intelligence can then cue artillery, missiles or other strike assets. The goal is simple: Cut the time between spotting a target and hitting it.

Your phone started as rocks. So did your laptop, your car battery, and the jumbotron displaying your favorite team’s score. Before any of that technology existed, the raw materials inside it (minerals!) had to be found and understood. Minerals are naturally occurring substances with specific chemical compositions and crystal structures. They form through the Earth’s natural processes and are the building blocks of the rocks beneath our feet. Some minerals are especially important to modern life and the technologies we rely on every day, many of which are critical minerals. Critical minerals are both essential to the Nation’s economy or national security AND have supply chains that are vulnerable to disruptions, such as changes in trade, natural disasters, or global instability. The USGS leads the U.S. government in developing the List of Critical Minerals. USGS scientists study how and where these minerals form, and collect and analyze data on global production, demand, trade, and recycling to identify risks to mineral supply chains that sometimes span the globe. The USGS also delivers essential science to inform questions like: 🪨Where might undiscovered resources be, and how much? 🪨Is there critical mineral potential in waste materials left over from mining? 🪨How do critical minerals move through air, water, and soil? From rock to resource, USGS science helps decision makers, industries, and the public better understand the materials that power our world. Fascinating thread on growing pressure Iran is under Hamidreza Azizi (@HamidRezaAz) #Iran’s Growing Debate Over How to End the War 🔹The differences within Iran’s leadership over how to proceed with the war are becoming increasingly visible. 🔹Today, both President Masoud Pezeshkian and Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf made unusually direct comments about the need to end the war and the economic costs of continuing it. 🔹Ghalibaf said that regardless of how much military power Iran possesses, “if people are hungry” and there is no economic growth, the country cannot endure. Security, he argued, cannot be sustained without a functioning economy. He then added that, as someone with a military background, “we know the value of peace better than those who talk about peace.” 🔹That last point is important. Ghalibaf has increasingly positioned himself alongside Pezeshkian in arguing for a diplomatic way out, while pushing back against hardliners who portray such an approach as capitulation. 🔹Pezeshkian was even more direct: “The war must end at some point.” His argument was that Iran should end it now, while Tehran still believes it is negotiating from a position of strength, rather than wait until its economic situation deteriorates further. He also lashed out at critics of his administration, saying those sitting “outside the ring” have little understanding of the pressures the government is actually facing. 🔹These comments come amid increasingly open acknowledgments of Iran’s economic problems. Central Bank Governor Abdolnaser Hemmati recently admitted on state television that Iran cannot sell its oil because of the blockade. Trump’s new economic pressure campaign is making the situation even more difficult. 🔹There is also a growing concern about Hormuz. Before the latest two weeks of fighting, Ghalibaf had already warned that the Strait has strategic value only as long as ships continue to use it. If traffic remains disrupted, other countries will inevitably search for alternatives. 🔹That appears to be happening. Reports that millions of barrels of oil are already being moved through alternative routes are now being cited by the more pragmatic camp as evidence that Iran cannot rely indefinitely on disruption in Hormuz as its main source of leverage. This is consistent with the broader problem I discussed earlier: Iran can impose substantial costs through Hormuz, but it cannot remain in a permanent state of confrontation with the U.S. and the GCC states. 🔹The problem is that the hardliners also have a point. According to them, even if Tehran is prepared to return to diplomacy, there is little indication that Trump wants to return to the previous terms. His new economic campaign suggests that Washington may instead use Iran’s growing difficulties to demand more. 🔹This is creating a vicious circle. The longer the confrontation continues, the stronger the economic case for diplomacy becomes. But the more Washington increases pressure, the harder it becomes for Iranian leaders to make concessions without appearing to capitulate. 🔹What is becoming clearer, however, is that an important part of Iran’s leadership now believes that the current situation is not sustainable and that the military leverage accumulated during the war needs to be translated into a diplomatic outcome sooner rather than later. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/HamidRezaAz/status/2090781076159406330#m

CAYERON LAS VENTAS EN SUPERMERCADOS, MAYORISTAS Y SHOPPINGS EN JUNIO, SEGÚN EL INDEC El consumo masivo volvió a mostrar signos de deterioro en junio, de acuerdo con los datos que difundió el Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Censos (Indec) sobre la actividad de los tres canales formales más relevantes del comercio minorista. Los supermercados, los autoservicios mayoristas y los centros de compras tuvieron bajas mensuales en sus ventas de 1%, 1,4% y 6,2% respectivamente, medidas a precios constantes, Los tres canales cayeron además en la comparación interanual y en los acumulados del primer semestre del año. En el caso de los supermercados, la comparación interanual muestra una retracción de 3,1%, mientras que el acumulado del semestre arrojó una baja de 2,8% frente a igual período de 2025. Medidas a precios corrientes, las ventas de los supermercados sumaron $2.484.975,5 millones en junio, con un incremento de 23,7% respecto al mismo mes del año pasado. Ese salto nominal responde en gran medida al efecto de la inflación sobre los precios, más que a una recuperación real de las cantidades vendidas. Los rubros que más subieron en los súpers: En ese universo de precios corrientes, y con la salvedad de que se trata de variaciones nominales y no de valores reales, los rubros que mostraron los aumentos más pronunciados fueron Carnes, con una suba interanual de 39%, y Electrónicos y artículos para el hogar, con 35,1%. También se destacaron Verdulería y frutería, con 30,6%, y Alimentos preparados y rotisería, con 23,6%. En el otro extremo, Indumentaria, calzado y textiles para el hogar fue el único rubro que retrocedió, con una caída de 7,4% frente a junio de 2025. Infobae 📎 infob.ae/4gd9u8B

Internal Bundeswehr documents show new delays on two key Rheinmetall programmes: the Skyranger air defence system and the Schwerer Waffenträger Infanterie (Boxer HWC). The German procurement office cited “insufficient maturity and quality.” Both projects fall under the Zeitenwende rearmament drive, of which Rheinmetall has been the largest beneficiary. On the Schwerer Waffenträger, the programme faces at least an 11-month delay. First series deliveries, originally planned for 2025, are now expected in Q3 2026. Early vehicles were anticipated with only minimum capabilities. On Skyranger, first qualification test vehicles are due in December, with full qualification by mid-2027 and the first series vehicle in August 2027. The original schedule called for four series vehicles this year. The procurement office said contractor performance is “in strong need of improvement” and that Rheinmetall Electronics lacks core competency for a complete wheeled weapon system. Rheinmetall rejects the sharper criticism. Source: Defence Blog #Bundeswehr #Rheinmetall #Skyranger #Boxer #Zeitenwende #DefenseIndustry

Fascinating thread on growing pressure Iran is under Hamidreza Azizi (@HamidRezaAz) #Iran’s Growing Debate Over How to End the War 🔹The differences within Iran’s leadership over how to proceed with the war are becoming increasingly visible. 🔹Today, both President Masoud Pezeshkian and Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf made unusually direct comments about the need to end the war and the economic costs of continuing it. 🔹Ghalibaf said that regardless of how much military power Iran possesses, “if people are hungry” and there is no economic growth, the country cannot endure. Security, he argued, cannot be sustained without a functioning economy. He then added that, as someone with a military background, “we know the value of peace better than those who talk about peace.” 🔹That last point is important. Ghalibaf has increasingly positioned himself alongside Pezeshkian in arguing for a diplomatic way out, while pushing back against hardliners who portray such an approach as capitulation. 🔹Pezeshkian was even more direct: “The war must end at some point.” His argument was that Iran should end it now, while Tehran still believes it is negotiating from a position of strength, rather than wait until its economic situation deteriorates further. He also lashed out at critics of his administration, saying those sitting “outside the ring” have little understanding of the pressures the government is actually facing. 🔹These comments come amid increasingly open acknowledgments of Iran’s economic problems. Central Bank Governor Abdolnaser Hemmati recently admitted on state television that Iran cannot sell its oil because of the blockade. Trump’s new economic pressure campaign is making the situation even more difficult. 🔹There is also a growing concern about Hormuz. Before the latest two weeks of fighting, Ghalibaf had already warned that the Strait has strategic value only as long as ships continue to use it. If traffic remains disrupted, other countries will inevitably search for alternatives. 🔹That appears to be happening. Reports that millions of barrels of oil are already being moved through alternative routes are now being cited by the more pragmatic camp as evidence that Iran cannot rely indefinitely on disruption in Hormuz as its main source of leverage. This is consistent with the broader problem I discussed earlier: Iran can impose substantial costs through Hormuz, but it cannot remain in a permanent state of confrontation with the U.S. and the GCC states. 🔹The problem is that the hardliners also have a point. According to them, even if Tehran is prepared to return to diplomacy, there is little indication that Trump wants to return to the previous terms. His new economic campaign suggests that Washington may instead use Iran’s growing difficulties to demand more. 🔹This is creating a vicious circle. The longer the confrontation continues, the stronger the economic case for diplomacy becomes. But the more Washington increases pressure, the harder it becomes for Iranian leaders to make concessions without appearing to capitulate. 🔹What is becoming clearer, however, is that an important part of Iran’s leadership now believes that the current situation is not sustainable and that the military leverage accumulated during the war needs to be translated into a diplomatic outcome sooner rather than later. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/HamidRezaAz/status/2090781076159406330#m

RICARDO MOLLO LEVANTÓ LA BANDERA DE MALVINAS EN UN CONCIERTO DE DIVIDIDOS: “SON ARGENTINAS" | Por Lucía Consiglieri El partido de la semifinal del Mundial 2026 fue un antes y después para la selección argentina. El equipo dirigido por Lionel Scaloni se enfrentó a Inglaterra por un lugar en la final del mundo y, tras la victoria del seleccionado albiceleste, una bandera blanca con letras negras que decía “Las Malvinas son Argentinas” fue lanzada desde la tribuna y sirvió como un reclamo por la soberanía de las Islas Malvinas. A raíz de esto la FIFA inició una investigación y que hoy, viernes 21 de agosto, se dieron a conocer las consecuencias. En este contexto, Ricardo Mollo, el cantante y guitarrista de Divididos, en el Teatro de Flores, sacó a relucir una réplica de la bandera. Alguien del público lanzó la bandera al escenario durante el show número 185 de Divididos en ese recinto, en el marco de la celebración de los 38 años de la banda. Mollo la recibió, la desplegó frente al micrófono y habló. La primera capa de sus palabras era el reclamo de soberanía que la bandera ya enunciaba por sí sola. “Malvinas son argentinas”, dijo. Esa parte era esperable, casi inevitable dado el contexto. Lo que siguió fue distinto. “Pero la República Argentina también es Argentina. Ojo”, agregó el músico, y la conjunción adversativa fue el núcleo de todo. No alcanza con reclamar las islas si el país que las reclama necesita ser defendido también desde adentro.
